                --disallowedTools NotebookEdit WebSearch WebFetch 2>&1 |
            Tee-Object -FilePath $RawLog |
            ForEach-Object {
                $Line = [string]$_

                try {
                    $Event = $Line | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop
                }
                catch {
                    if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Line)) {
                        Write-Host "[RAW] $Line" -ForegroundColor DarkGray
                    }
                    return
                }

                if ($Event.type -eq "system") {
                    if ($Event.subtype -eq "init") {
                        Write-Host "[AGENT] Gauntlet V2 session resumed" -ForegroundColor Cyan
                    }
                    elseif ($Event.subtype -eq "api_retry") {
                        Write-Host "[RETRY] API retry $($Event.attempt)/$($Event.max_retries)" -ForegroundColor Yellow
                    }
                }
                elseif ($Event.type -eq "stream_event") {
                    $Inner = $Event.event

                    if (
                        $Inner.type -eq "content_block_start" -and
                        $Inner.content_block.type -eq "tool_use"
                    ) {
                        Write-Host ""
                        Write-Host "[TOOL] $($Inner.content_block.name)" -ForegroundColor DarkCyan
                    }
                    elseif (
                        $Inner.type -eq "content_block_delta" -and
                        $Inner.delta.type -eq "text_delta"
                    ) {
                        Write-Host $Inner.delta.text -NoNewline
                    }
                    elseif ($Inner.type -eq "message_stop") {
                        Write-Host ""
                    }
                }
                elseif ($Event.type -eq "result") {
                    Write-Host ""

                    if ($Event.is_error) {
                        Write-Host "[BLOCKED] Gauntlet V2 builder returned an error" -ForegroundColor Red
                    }
                    else {
                        Write-Host "[DONE] Gauntlet V2 builder completed" -ForegroundColor Green
                    }

                    if ($null -ne $Event.total_cost_usd) {
                        Write-Host "[USAGE] Cost: `$$($Event.total_cost_usd)"
                    }
                }
            }

        $ClaudeExit = $LASTEXITCODE
    }
    finally {
        $ErrorActionPreference = $PreviousErrorPreference
    }

    if ($ClaudeExit -ne 0) {
        throw "Gauntlet V2 builder failed with exit code $ClaudeExit. Raw log: $RawLog"
    }

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "[STATE] Gauntlet V2 history:" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    git log --oneline --decorate -12

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "[STATE] Real changes from V1:" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    git diff --ignore-cr-at-eol $BackupBranch...HEAD --name-status

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "[STATE] Checkout:"
    git status --short

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "[DONE] Gauntlet V2 build finished." -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host "[LOG] $RawLog"
}

        throw "Could not refresh main."
    }

    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "main advanced relative to the tested Stage 3 head."
    }

    Write-Host "[WORK] Merging exact CI-tested Stage 3 head" -ForegroundColor Cyan

    $MergeJson = gh api --method PUT "repos/$Repo/pulls/$PrNumber/merge" -f "merge_method=merge" -f "sha=$ExpectedHead"
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "GitHub merge failed."
    }

    $Merge = $MergeJson | ConvertFrom-Json

    if (-not $Merge.merged) {
        throw "GitHub refused merge: $($Merge.message)"
    }

    git switch main
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "Could not switch to main."
    }

    git pull --ff-only origin main
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "Could not update main."
    }

    git merge-base --is-ancestor $ExpectedHead main
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "Stage 3 tested head is not in main."
    }

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "============================================================" -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host "[DONE] STAGE 3 IS IN MAIN" -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host "============================================================" -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host "[STATE] Tested head: $ExpectedHead"
    Write-Host "[STATE] Merge commit: $($Merge.sha)"

Yes. Stage 4 should be much narrower than Stage 3. The central change is:

generic worker
→ resume existing work if available
→ otherwise select fresh candidate A
→ lose atomic claim
→ refresh authoritative plan
→ exclude A for this invocation
→ try B
→ repeat until work starts or no candidate remains

I would give Sonnet this prompt once main is clean and contains the missing Stage 3 CI regression.

IMPLEMENT STAGE 4 — GENERIC CONTENTION RETRY / N-WORKER DISPATCH

You are working in the NoSafeCircle repository.

Stage 0, Stage 1, Stage 2, and Stage 3 are complete and merged.

Start by inspecting the CURRENT main branch and its actual implementation.
Do not rely on old assumptions if the repository disagrees with this prompt.

The relevant existing architecture includes:

- Stage 1 atomic Git-ref claims for task + exclusive resources.
- Stage 2 deterministic read-only dispatch planning.
- Stage 3 generic no-TaskId fresh dispatch:
    resume existing actionable durable work first;
    otherwise select one safe fresh implementation candidate;
    revalidate current authority;
    atomically claim task/resources;
    only after claim success initialize/acquire durable Issue authority;
    exact authority reread;
    release ephemeral claim;
    continue through the existing production orchestrator.
- Explicit TaskId fresh admission uses the same Stage 2 safety kernel.
- Observe mode is read-only.
- GitHub Issue workflow is long-lived authority.
- Stage 1 claims are short-lived arbitration only.
- autonomous/background dispatch remains disabled.
- Stage 5 decomposition is NOT implemented yet.

Stage 3 deliberately stopped after a claim conflict.

Stage 4 changes ONLY that boundary.

============================================================
STAGE 4 GOAL
============================================================

Make the SAME generic no-TaskId command safe and useful when MANY
independent orchestrators run concurrently.

Example:

worker A selects NSC-101
worker B selects NSC-101
worker C selects NSC-101

worker A wins the Stage 1 atomic claim.

worker B loses the claim.

worker C loses the claim.

Stage 3 behavior:

B -> claim_conflict -> stop
C -> claim_conflict -> stop

Required Stage 4 behavior:

B
-> record contention on NSC-101
-> refresh the authoritative read-only dispatch plan
-> do NOT select NSC-101 again during this invocation
-> select next currently safe candidate
-> attempt it

C does the same independently.

Continue until:

A. this worker successfully starts/resumes useful work;

OR

B. there is no currently safe untried candidate remaining;

OR

C. a NON-CONTENTION failure occurs and the invocation must fail closed.

There is NO hard-coded number of workers.

The implementation must work for:

2
10
20
or more

independent processes all running the same generic command.

Do NOT build a scheduler.

============================================================
1. RETRY ONLY NORMAL CLAIM CONTENTION
============================================================

Stage 4 retry is specifically for ordinary concurrency contention.

Retry after the existing typed:

claim_conflict

outcome.

This includes legitimate atomic task/resource claim race loss as already
classified by Stage 3.

DO NOT retry another task after:

claim_operational_error
blocked_invalid_state
issue_initialization_blocked
lease_acquired_claim_cleanup_required
unexpected programmer/contract exceptions
Git failure
invalid committed policy
invalid managed Issue state
HEAD safety failure
cleanup failure

Those are NOT ordinary scheduler contention.

They must continue to fail closed.

Do not broaden exception handling to make Stage 4 look successful.

============================================================
2. NEVER SUBSTITUTE FOR EXPLICIT TASK-ID
============================================================

Retry/substitution applies ONLY to the generic no-TaskId command.

If the operator explicitly requests:

-TaskId NSC-123

and NSC-123 cannot safely start, report the exact NSC-123 outcome.

NEVER silently choose NSC-124.

Preserve the Stage 3 explicit fresh-admission behavior.

============================================================

============================================================

Do not add retry mutation behavior to:

Generic observe remains a read-only Stage 2 planning observation.

============================================================

existing actionable durable work
MUST beat

The SAME rule applies after a claim conflict.

Suppose:

worker B loses a fresh claim

B must resume that actionable durable work before selecting another fresh task.

Do not implement retry as:

"take the next item from the old list."

Every retry must refresh current authority.

============================================================

- HEAD/source commit

- Stage 1 claim observations
- dependency readiness
- ranking/frontier

Do not trust the previously returned candidate list as current authority.

============================================================

A worker that loses candidate X must not immediately spin and select X again.

contended = []

select NSC-101
claim conflict
contended = [NSC-101]

refresh plan

NSC-101 must not be selected again by THIS invocation.

It is NOT globally invalid.

It is only:

Other workers remain free to evaluate NSC-101 normally.

============================================================

============================================================

============================================================

The retry loop must be structurally finite.

A task already in that set must never be attempted again by that invocation.

The TaskGraph is finite, therefore the invocation naturally terminates after
at most one contention loss per distinct attempted task.

Do NOT add:

background polling
timer scheduler
arbitrary retry storm
random backoff as authority

Small implementation-level jitter is unnecessary; atomic claims already

& {
    $ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
    $env:PYTHONUTF8 = "1"

    # ============================================================
    # STAGE 4 — FULL IMPLEMENTATION RUNNER
    # Generic contention retry / N-worker dispatch
    # ============================================================

    $Root = "C:\NSC\NSC\NoSafeCircle"
    $BaseBranch = "main"
    $Stage4Branch = "generic-get-work-stage4-contention-retry"
    $MaxTurns = 150

    $PromptPath = Join-Path $env:TEMP "nsc-stage4-contention-retry-prompt.txt"
    $RawLog = Join-Path $env:TEMP (
        "nsc-stage4-contention-retry-" +
        (Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd-HHmmss") +
        ".jsonl"
    )
    $SessionPath = Join-Path $env:TEMP (
        "nsc-stage4-session-" +
        (Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd-HHmmss") +
        ".txt"
    )

        "nsc-stage4-result-" +
        (Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd-HHmmss") +
        ".txt"
    )

    Set-Location $Root

    function Invoke-Checked {
        param(
            [string]$Name,
            [scriptblock]$Command
        )

        Write-Host ""
        Write-Host "[TEST] $Name" -ForegroundColor Cyan

        & $Command

        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            throw "$Name failed."
        }

        Write-Host "[PASS] $Name" -ForegroundColor Green
    }

    Write-Host "============================================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host "[START] STAGE 4 — GENERIC CONTENTION RETRY" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host "============================================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan

    # ============================================================
    # 1. PRE-FLIGHT: REQUIRE CLEAN, CURRENT MAIN
    # ============================================================

    $CurrentBranch = (git branch --show-current).Trim()

    if ($CurrentBranch -ne $BaseBranch) {
        throw "Expected to begin Stage 4 on '$BaseBranch'. Current branch is '$CurrentBranch'."
    }

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "[READ] Refreshing origin/main" -ForegroundColor Cyan

    git fetch origin main
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "Could not fetch origin/main."
    }

    git pull --ff-only origin main
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "Local main could not fast-forward to origin/main."
    }

    $LocalMain = (git rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
    $RemoteMain = (git rev-parse origin/main).Trim()

    if ($LocalMain -ne $RemoteMain) {
        throw "Local main does not exactly match origin/main."
    }

    Write-Host "[STATE] main: $LocalMain"

    # Real unstaged changes, ignoring CRLF-only noise.
    git diff --ignore-cr-at-eol --quiet
    $UnstagedExit = $LASTEXITCODE

    if ($UnstagedExit -ne 0) {
        Write-Host ""
        Write-Host "[BLOCKED] Real unstaged content changes exist:" -ForegroundColor Red
        git diff --ignore-cr-at-eol --name-status
        throw "Stage 4 requires a clean main checkout."
    }

    # Staged changes.
    git diff --cached --quiet
    $StagedExit = $LASTEXITCODE

    if ($StagedExit -ne 0) {
        Write-Host ""
        Write-Host "[BLOCKED] Staged changes exist:" -ForegroundColor Red
        git diff --cached --name-status
        throw "Stage 4 requires an empty index."
    }

    # Untracked, non-ignored files.
    $Untracked = @(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)

    if ($Untracked.Count -gt 0) {
        Write-Host ""
        Write-Host "[BLOCKED] Untracked files exist:" -ForegroundColor Red
        $Untracked | ForEach-Object {
            Write-Host "  $_"
        }
        throw "Stage 4 requires a clean checkout."
    }

    Write-Host "[PASS] main working tree is clean" -ForegroundColor Green

    # ============================================================
    # 2. VERIFY STAGE 3 + ITS CI REGRESSION ARE ACTUALLY IN MAIN
    # ============================================================

    $FreshDispatchPath =

    }

    # ============================================================

    $Stage4BranchExists = ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0)

At most one owns the resource.

The loser refreshes and can acquire a disjoint candidate.

============================================================
35. TEST M — DISJOINT CONCURRENCY
============================================================

Two or more workers with disjoint tasks/resources may both acquire useful
work.

Prove Stage 4 added no global serialization.

============================================================
36. TEST N — NO DUPLICATE AUTHORITATIVE OWNERSHIP
============================================================

Contention must never result in two authoritative managed workflows for one
task.

Use real authority machinery where practical.

============================================================
37. MULTI-WORKER STRESS TEST
============================================================

Run a lightweight deterministic stress test with MORE THAN TWO workers.

Prefer five workers in routine CI unless ten is still fast and deterministic.

Ten workers will be exercised later by the large Gauntlet.

The focused test should prove:

- every worker terminates;
- no duplicate task winner;
- multiple workers acquire distinct useful tasks where work exists;
- claim losers do not corrupt state;
- no leaked claims after successful handoff/cleanup;
- no infinite retry loop.

Do not make routine CI flaky merely to use ten processes.

Document the worker count chosen.

    # ============================================================
    # 5. WRITE PROMPT AS UTF-8 WITHOUT BOM
    # ============================================================

    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(
        $PromptPath,
        (($Prompt -replace "`r`n", "`n") -replace "`r", "`n"),
        (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false))
    )

    if (Test-Path $SessionPath) {
        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $SessionPath -Force
    }

    if (Test-Path $ResultStatePath) {
        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $ResultStatePath -Force
    }

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "[AGENT] Launching Claude Sonnet for Stage 4" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host "[MODEL] sonnet"
    Write-Host "[MAX-TURNS] $MaxTurns"
    Write-Host "[PROMPT] $PromptPath"
    Write-Host "[LOG] $RawLog"
    Write-Host ""

    # ============================================================
    # 6. RUN CLAUDE WITH LIVE STREAMING + SESSION CAPTURE
    # ============================================================

    $PreviousErrorPreference = $ErrorActionPreference

    try {
        # Docker emits harmless compose status on stderr. Do not let native
        # stderr itself terminate PowerShell.
        $ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"

        Get-Content -LiteralPath $PromptPath -Raw -Encoding UTF8 |
            docker compose -p nosafecircle run --rm -T claude `
                claude -p `
                --model sonnet `
                --max-turns $MaxTurns `
                --permission-mode dontAsk `
                --output-format stream-json `
                --verbose `
                --include-partial-messages `
                --tools Read,Glob,Grep,Edit,Write,Bash `
                --allowedTools Read Glob Grep Edit Write Bash `
                --disallowedTools NotebookEdit WebSearch WebFetch 2>&1 |
            Tee-Object -FilePath $RawLog |
            ForEach-Object {

                $Line = [string]$_

                try {
                    $Event =
                        $Line |
                        ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop
                }
                catch {
                    if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Line)) {
                        Write-Host "[RAW] $Line" -ForegroundColor DarkGray
                    }

                    return
                }

                if ($Event.type -eq "system") {

                    if ($Event.subtype -eq "init") {

                        Write-Host "[AGENT] Claude session started" -ForegroundColor Cyan

                        if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$Event.session_id)) {

                            [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(
                                $SessionPath,
                                [string]$Event.session_id,
                                (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false))
                            )

                            Write-Host "[SESSION] $($Event.session_id)" -ForegroundColor DarkCyan
                        }
                    }
                    elseif ($Event.subtype -eq "api_retry") {

                        Write-Host (
                            "[RETRY] API retry " +
                            "$($Event.attempt)/$($Event.max_retries)"
                        ) -ForegroundColor Yellow
                    }
                }
                elseif ($Event.type -eq "stream_event") {

                    $Inner = $Event.event

                    if (
                        $Inner.type -eq "content_block_start" -and
                        $Inner.content_block.type -eq "tool_use"
                    ) {

                        Write-Host ""
                        Write-Host (
                            "[TOOL] " +
                            [string]$Inner.content_block.name
                        ) -ForegroundColor DarkCyan
                    }
                    elseif (
                        $Inner.type -eq "content_block_delta" -and
                        $Inner.delta.type -eq "text_delta"
                    ) {

                        Write-Host $Inner.delta.text -NoNewline
                    }
                    elseif ($Inner.type -eq "message_stop") {

                        Write-Host ""
                    }
                }
                elseif ($Event.type -eq "result") {

                    Write-Host ""

                    if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$Event.session_id)) {

                        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(
                            $SessionPath,
                            [string]$Event.session_id,
                            (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false))
                        )

                        Write-Host "[SESSION] $($Event.session_id)" -ForegroundColor DarkCyan
                    }

                    if ($Event.is_error) {

                        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(
                            $ResultStatePath,
                            "error",
                            (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false))
                        )

                        Write-Host "[BLOCKED] Claude returned an error" -ForegroundColor Red
                    }
                    else {

                        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(
                            $ResultStatePath,
                            "success",
                            (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false))
                        )

                        Write-Host "[DONE] Claude Stage 4 implementation pass completed" -ForegroundColor Green
                    }

                    if ($null -ne $Event.total_cost_usd) {

                        Write-Host (
                            "[USAGE] Cost: $" +
                            [string]$Event.total_cost_usd
                        )
                    }
                }
            }

        $ClaudeExit = $LASTEXITCODE
    }
    finally {
        $ErrorActionPreference = $PreviousErrorPreference
    }

    # ============================================================
    # 7. INSPECT CLAUDE TERMINATION STATE
    # ============================================================

    $ClaudeState = ""

    if (Test-Path $ResultStatePath) {
        $ClaudeState =
            (Get-Content -LiteralPath $ResultStatePath -Raw).Trim()
    }

    $ClaudeSession = ""

    if (Test-Path $SessionPath) {
        $ClaudeSession =
            (Get-Content -LiteralPath $SessionPath -Raw).Trim()
    }

    if (
        $ClaudeExit -ne 0 -or
        $ClaudeState -ne "success"
    ) {
        Write-Host ""
        Write-Host "============================================================" -ForegroundColor Red
        Write-Host "[BLOCKED] STAGE 4 AGENT DID NOT FINISH CLEANLY" -ForegroundColor Red
        Write-Host "============================================================" -ForegroundColor Red

        Write-Host "[STATE] Docker/Claude exit: $ClaudeExit"
        Write-Host "[STATE] Result state: $ClaudeState"
        Write-Host "[LOG] $RawLog"

        if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($ClaudeSession)) {
            Write-Host "[SESSION] $ClaudeSession"
            Write-Host ""
            Write-Host "Keep this session ID. If the run simply hit max-turns, resume THIS session rather than restarting it." -ForegroundColor Yellow
        }

        Write-Host ""
        Write-Host "[STATE] Working tree left by interrupted Stage 4 pass:" -ForegroundColor Cyan
        git status --short

        Write-Host ""
        Write-Host "[STATE] Real content changes:" -ForegroundColor Cyan
        git diff --ignore-cr-at-eol --name-status

        throw "Stage 4 implementation agent did not complete successfully. Inspect/upload the JSONL log before continuing."
    }

    # ============================================================
    # 8. INDEPENDENT POST-AGENT VALIDATION
    # ============================================================

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "============================================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host "[TEST] INDEPENDENT STAGE 4 VERIFICATION" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host "============================================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan

    $Stage4Test =
        "Pipeline\TaskReviewAgent\tests\contention_retry_smoke_test.py"

    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Stage4Test -PathType Leaf)) {
        throw "Claude reported success but did not create $Stage4Test."
    }

    Invoke-Checked "Stage 4 contention retry" {
        python Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent/tests/contention_retry_smoke_test.py
    }

    Invoke-Checked "Stage 3 fresh dispatch regression" {
        python Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent/tests/fresh_dispatch_smoke_test.py
    }

    Invoke-Checked "Stage 2 dispatch regression" {
        python Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent/tests/dispatch_plan_smoke_test.py
    }

    Invoke-Checked "Stage 1 claim regression" {
        python Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent/tests/claim_refs_smoke_test.py
    }

    Invoke-Checked "Resource reservation regression" {
        python Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent/tests/resource_reservation_smoke_test.py
    }

    Invoke-Checked "Issue workflow regression" {
        python Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent/tests/issue_workflow_smoke_test.py
    }

    Invoke-Checked "Workflow runtime regression" {
        python Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent/tests/workflow_runtime_smoke_test.py
    }

    Invoke-Checked "Core CI routing regression" {
        python Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent/tests/ci_workflow_split_smoke_test.py
    }

    Invoke-Checked "TaskGraph validation" {
        python Pipeline/TaskGraph/taskcontrol.py validate
    }

    Invoke-Checked "TaskReviewAgent compile" {
        python -m compileall -q Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent
    }

    Invoke-Checked "Whitespace validation" {
        git -c core.whitespace=cr-at-eol diff --check
    }

    # ============================================================
    # 9. FINAL CANDIDATE STATE
    # ============================================================

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "============================================================" -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host "[PASS] STAGE 4 CANDIDATE PASSED LOCAL VERIFICATION" -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host "============================================================" -ForegroundColor Green

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "[STATE] Branch:" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    git branch --show-current

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "[STATE] Working tree:" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    git status --short

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "[STATE] REAL content changes:" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    git diff --ignore-cr-at-eol --name-status

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "[STATE] Real diff statistics:" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    git diff --ignore-cr-at-eol --stat

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "[LOG] $RawLog"

    if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($ClaudeSession)) {
        Write-Host "[SESSION] $ClaudeSession"
    }

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "[DONE] Stage 4 is ready for adversarial review." -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host "[NEXT] Do NOT commit or push yet." -ForegroundColor Yellow
}

This runner deliberately does not depend on the Gauntlet finishing. Claude will build a smaller disposable concurrency harness for Stage 4 itself, including real Git-ref contention. The large dice/Fibonacci Gauntlet becomes our full acceptance test once Stage 4 and then Stage 5 are ready.

    Write-Host "[LOG] $RawLog"
    Write-Host ""

    $PreviousErrorPreference = $ErrorActionPreference

    try {
        $ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"

        Get-Content -LiteralPath $PromptPath -Raw -Encoding UTF8 |
            docker compose -p nosafecircle run --rm -T claude `
                claude -p `
                --resume $SessionId `
                --model sonnet `
                --max-turns $MaxTurns `

                --output-format stream-json `
                --verbose `
                --include-partial-messages `
                --tools Read,Glob,Grep,Edit,Write,Bash `
                --allowedTools Read Glob Grep Edit Write Bash `
                --disallowedTools NotebookEdit WebSearch WebFetch 2>&1 |
            Tee-Object -FilePath $RawLog |
            ForEach-Object {
                $Line = [string]$_

                try {
                    $Event = $Line | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop
                }
                catch {
                    if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Line)) {
                        Write-Host "[RAW] $Line" -ForegroundColor DarkGray
                    }
                    return
                }

                if ($Event.type -eq "system") {
                    if ($Event.subtype -eq "init") {
                        Write-Host "[AGENT] Gauntlet V2 session resumed" -ForegroundColor Cyan

                        if ($Event.session_id) {
                            Write-Host "[SESSION] $($Event.session_id)" -ForegroundColor DarkCyan
                        }
                    }
                    elseif ($Event.subtype -eq "api_retry") {
                        Write-Host "[RETRY] API retry $($Event.attempt)/$($Event.max_retries)" -ForegroundColor Yellow
                    }
                }
                elseif ($Event.type -eq "stream_event") {
                    $Inner = $Event.event

                    if (
                        $Inner.type -eq "content_block_start" -and
                        $Inner.content_block.type -eq "tool_use"
                    ) {
                        Write-Host ""
                        Write-Host "[TOOL] $($Inner.content_block.name)" -ForegroundColor DarkCyan
                    }
                    elseif (
                        $Inner.type -eq "content_block_delta" -and
                        $Inner.delta.type -eq "text_delta"
                    ) {
                        Write-Host $Inner.delta.text -NoNewline
                    }
                    elseif ($Inner.type -eq "message_stop") {
                        Write-Host ""
                    }
                }
                elseif ($Event.type -eq "result") {
                    Write-Host ""

                    if ($Event.is_error) {
                        Write-Host "[BLOCKED] Resumed Gauntlet V2 session returned an error" -ForegroundColor Red
                    }
                    else {
                        Write-Host "[DONE] Resumed Gauntlet V2 build completed" -ForegroundColor Green
                    }

                    if ($Event.session_id) {
                        Write-Host "[SESSION] $($Event.session_id)" -ForegroundColor DarkCyan
                    }

                    if ($null -ne $Event.total_cost_usd) {
                        Write-Host "[USAGE] Cost: `$$($Event.total_cost_usd)"
                    }
                }
            }

        $ClaudeExit = $LASTEXITCODE
    }
    finally {
        $ErrorActionPreference = $PreviousErrorPreference
    }

    if ($ClaudeExit -ne 0) {
        Write-Host ""
        Write-Host "[STATE] Current V2 tree after interrupted resume:" -ForegroundColor Cyan
        git status --short

        Write-Host ""
        Write-Host "[STATE] Real content changes:" -ForegroundColor Cyan

        Write-Host ""
        Write-Host "[LOG] $RawLog"

        throw "Gauntlet V2 resume stopped with exit code $ClaudeExit. Preserve this session and log."

    $Prompt = $ReviewPrompt + $CandidateContext

    Write-Host "[MAX-TURNS] $MaxTurns"

    Write-Host "[PROMPT] $PromptPath"
    Write-Host "[LOG] $RawLog"

    # 7. RUN FABLE — PHYSICALLY READ-ONLY TOOL SET
    # ============================================================

    $PreviousErrorPreference = $ErrorActionPreference

    try {
        $ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"

                --max-turns $MaxTurns `

                --tools Read,Glob,Grep `
                --allowedTools Read Glob Grep `
                --disallowedTools Bash Edit Write NotebookEdit WebSearch WebFetch 2>&1 |
            Tee-Object -FilePath $RawLog |
            ForEach-Object {
                $Line = [string]$_

                try {
                    $Event = $Line | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop
                }
                catch {
                    if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Line)) {
                        Write-Host "[RAW] $Line" -ForegroundColor DarkGray
                    }

                    return
                }

                if ($Event.type -eq "system") {
                    if ($Event.subtype -eq "init") {
                        Write-Host "[REVIEW] Fable session started" -ForegroundColor Magenta

                        if ($Event.session_id) {
                            [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(
                                $SessionPath,
                                [string]$Event.session_id,
                                (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false))
                            )

                            Write-Host "[SESSION] $($Event.session_id)" -ForegroundColor DarkCyan
                        }
                    }
                    elseif ($Event.subtype -eq "api_retry") {
                        Write-Host (
                            "[RETRY] API retry " +
                            "$($Event.attempt)/$($Event.max_retries)"
                        ) -ForegroundColor Yellow
                    }
                }
                elseif ($Event.type -eq "stream_event") {
                    $Inner = $Event.event

                    if (
                        $Inner.type -eq "content_block_start" -and
                        $Inner.content_block.type -eq "tool_use"
                    ) {
                        Write-Host ""
                        Write-Host "[TOOL] $($Inner.content_block.name)" -ForegroundColor DarkCyan
                    }
                    elseif (
                        $Inner.type -eq "content_block_delta" -and
                        $Inner.delta.type -eq "text_delta"
                    ) {
                        Write-Host $Inner.delta.text -NoNewline
                    }
                    elseif ($Inner.type -eq "message_stop") {
                        Write-Host ""
                    }
                }
                elseif ($Event.type -eq "result") {
                    Write-Host ""

                    if ($Event.session_id) {
                        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(
                            $SessionPath,
                            [string]$Event.session_id,
                            (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false))
                        )
                    }

                    if ($Event.is_error) {
                        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(
                            $ResultStatePath,
                            "error",
                            (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false))
                        )

                        Write-Host "[BLOCKED] Fable review returned an error" -ForegroundColor Red
                    }
                    else {
                        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(
                            $ResultStatePath,
                            "success",
                            (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false))
                        )

                        Write-Host "[DONE] Fable Stage 4 review completed" -ForegroundColor Green
                    }

                    if ($null -ne $Event.total_cost_usd) {
                        Write-Host "[USAGE] Cost: `$$($Event.total_cost_usd)"
                    }
                }
            }

        $FableExit = $LASTEXITCODE
    }
    finally {
        $ErrorActionPreference = $PreviousErrorPreference
    }

    # ============================================================
    # 8. VERIFY FABLE DID NOT CHANGE THE CANDIDATE
    # ============================================================

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "[VERIFY] Confirming read-only review" -ForegroundColor Cyan

    $AfterBranch = (git branch --show-current).Trim()
    $AfterHead = (git rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
    $AfterStatus = (
        @(git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all) -join "`n"
    )

    $AfterWorkDiffHash = (
        git diff --binary |
            git hash-object --stdin
    ).Trim()

    $AfterIndexDiffHash = (
        git diff --cached --binary |
            git hash-object --stdin
    ).Trim()

    if ($AfterBranch -ne $BeforeBranch) {
        throw "Fable review changed branch."
    }

    if ($AfterHead -ne $BeforeHead) {
        throw "Fable review changed HEAD."
    }

    if ($AfterStatus -ne $BeforeStatus) {
        Write-Host "[BLOCKED] Working-tree status changed during review:" -ForegroundColor Red
        git status --short
        throw "Read-only review invariant failed."
    }

    if ($AfterWorkDiffHash -ne $BeforeWorkDiffHash) {
        throw "Tracked Stage 4 candidate diff changed during review."
    }

    if ($AfterIndexDiffHash -ne $BeforeIndexDiffHash) {
        throw "Git index changed during review."
    }

    foreach ($Path in $ExpectedFiles) {
        $AfterHash = (
            Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $Path -Algorithm SHA256
        ).Hash

        if ($AfterHash -ne $BeforeFileHashes[$Path]) {
            throw "File changed during Fable review: $Path"
        }
    }

    Write-Host "[PASS] HEAD/index/worktree/files unchanged by Fable" -ForegroundColor Green

    # ============================================================
    # 9. REVIEW RESULT / SESSION
    # ============================================================

    $ReviewState = ""

    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $ResultStatePath) {
        $ReviewState = (
            Get-Content -LiteralPath $ResultStatePath -Raw
        ).Trim()
    }

    $ReviewSession = ""

    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $SessionPath) {
        $ReviewSession = (
            Get-Content -LiteralPath $SessionPath -Raw
        ).Trim()
    }

    if ($FableExit -ne 0 -or $ReviewState -ne "success") {
        Write-Host ""
        Write-Host "============================================================" -ForegroundColor Red
        Write-Host "[BLOCKED] FABLE REVIEW DID NOT COMPLETE CLEANLY" -ForegroundColor Red
        Write-Host "============================================================" -ForegroundColor Red
        Write-Host "[STATE] Exit code: $FableExit"
        Write-Host "[STATE] Review state: $ReviewState"
        Write-Host "[LOG] $RawLog"

        if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($ReviewSession)) {
            Write-Host "[SESSION] $ReviewSession"
            Write-Host "[NEXT] Resume this exact Fable session if it only hit max-turns." -ForegroundColor Yellow
        }

        throw "Stage 4 adversarial review did not finish."
    }

    # ============================================================
    # 10. SURFACE FINAL VERDICT
    # ============================================================

    $ReviewLogText = Get-Content -LiteralPath $RawLog -Raw

    $Verdict = "UNKNOWN"

    if ($ReviewLogText.Contains("STAGE 4 READY TO COMMIT")) {
        $Verdict = "STAGE 4 READY TO COMMIT"
    }
    elseif ($ReviewLogText.Contains("STAGE 4 READY AFTER NARROW REPAIRS")) {
        $Verdict = "STAGE 4 READY AFTER NARROW REPAIRS"
    }
    elseif ($ReviewLogText.Contains("STAGE 4 NOT READY")) {
        $Verdict = "STAGE 4 NOT READY"
    }

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "============================================================" -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host "[DONE] STAGE 4 FABLE REVIEW FINISHED" -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host "============================================================" -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host "[VERDICT] $Verdict"
    Write-Host "[LOG] $RawLog"

    if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($ReviewSession)) {
        Write-Host "[SESSION] $ReviewSession"
    }

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "[STATE] Candidate remains uncommitted:" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    git diff --ignore-cr-at-eol --name-status
    git status --short

    Write-Host ""

    if ($Verdict -eq "STAGE 4 READY TO COMMIT") {
        Write-Host "[NEXT] Stage 4 can move directly to the commit runner." -ForegroundColor Green
    }
    elseif ($Verdict -eq "STAGE 4 READY AFTER NARROW REPAIRS") {
        Write-Host "[NEXT] Send me the Fable JSONL. We will make only the warranted narrow repairs." -ForegroundColor Yellow
    }
    elseif ($Verdict -eq "STAGE 4 NOT READY") {
        Write-Host "[NEXT] Send me the Fable JSONL before changing anything." -ForegroundColor Red
    }
    else {
        Write-Host "[NEXT] Fable completed but its exact verdict was not detected. Send me the JSONL." -ForegroundColor Yellow
    }
}

                        Write-Host "[DONE] Claude verifier repair completed" -ForegroundColor Green
                    }

                    }
                }
            }

    }
    finally {
        $ErrorActionPreference = $PreviousErrorPreference
    }

    python Gauntlet/generate_fixture.py --check
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "Generator reproducibility failed."
    }

    python Gauntlet/verify_gauntlet.py --phase initial
    $VerifyExit = $LASTEXITCODE

    $Watch.Stop()

    Write-Host (
        "[STATE] Verifier runtime: " +
        [math]::Round($Watch.Elapsed.TotalSeconds, 2) +
        " seconds"
    )

    if ($VerifyExit -ne 0) {
        throw "Gauntlet initial verifier still fails."
    }

    Write-Host "[PASS] Initial verifier" -ForegroundColor Green

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "[TEST] TaskGraph" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    python Pipeline/TaskGraph/taskcontrol.py validate
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "TaskGraph validation failed."
    }

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "[TEST] Compile" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    python -m compileall -q Gauntlet Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent Pipeline/TaskGraph
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "Compile failed."
    }

    Write-Host "[TEST] Whitespace" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    git -c core.whitespace=cr-at-eol diff --check

        throw "Whitespace failed."
    }

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "============================================================" -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host "[PASS] GAUNTLET V2 FINAL LOCAL GATE PASSED" -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host "============================================================" -ForegroundColor Green

    Write-Host "[STATE] Recent history:" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    git log --oneline --decorate -15

    Write-Host "[LOG] $RawLog"
}

                --disallowedTools NotebookEdit WebSearch WebFetch 2>&1 |
            Tee-Object -FilePath $RawLog |
            ForEach-Object {
                $Line = [string]$_

                try {
                    $Event = $Line | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop
                }
                catch {
                    if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Line)) {
                        Write-Host "[RAW] $Line" -ForegroundColor DarkGray
                    }
                    return
                }

                if ($Event.type -eq "system") {
                    if ($Event.subtype -eq "init") {
                        Write-Host "[AGENT] Sonnet repair session started" -ForegroundColor Cyan

                        if ($Event.session_id) {
                            [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(
                                $SessionPath,
                                [string]$Event.session_id,
                                (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false))
                            )

                            Write-Host "[SESSION] $($Event.session_id)" -ForegroundColor DarkCyan
                        }
                    }
                    elseif ($Event.subtype -eq "api_retry") {
                        Write-Host "[RETRY] API retry $($Event.attempt)/$($Event.max_retries)" -ForegroundColor Yellow
                    }
                }
                elseif ($Event.type -eq "stream_event") {
                    $Inner = $Event.event

                    if (
                        $Inner.type -eq "content_block_start" -and
                        $Inner.content_block.type -eq "tool_use"
                    ) {
                        Write-Host ""
                        Write-Host "[TOOL] $($Inner.content_block.name)" -ForegroundColor DarkCyan
                    }
                    elseif (
                        $Inner.type -eq "content_block_delta" -and
                        $Inner.delta.type -eq "text_delta"
                    ) {
                        Write-Host $Inner.delta.text -NoNewline
                    }
                    elseif ($Inner.type -eq "message_stop") {
                        Write-Host ""
                    }
                }
                elseif ($Event.type -eq "result") {
                    Write-Host ""

                    if ($Event.session_id) {
                        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(
                            $SessionPath,
                            [string]$Event.session_id,
                            (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false))
                        )
                    }

                    if ($Event.is_error) {
                        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(
                            $ResultStatePath,
                            "error",
                            (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false))
                        )

                        Write-Host "[BLOCKED] Sonnet repair returned an error" -ForegroundColor Red
                    }
                    else {
                        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(
                            $ResultStatePath,
                            "success",
                            (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false))
                        )

                        Write-Host "[DONE] Sonnet Stage 4 repair completed" -ForegroundColor Green
                    }

                    if ($null -ne $Event.total_cost_usd) {
                        Write-Host "[USAGE] Cost: `$$($Event.total_cost_usd)"
                    }
                }
            }

        $ClaudeExit = $LASTEXITCODE
    }
    finally {
        $ErrorActionPreference = $PreviousErrorPreference
    }

    $ResultState = ""

    if (Test-Path $ResultStatePath) {
        $ResultState = (Get-Content -LiteralPath $ResultStatePath -Raw).Trim()
    }

    $SessionId = ""

    if (Test-Path $SessionPath) {
        $SessionId = (Get-Content -LiteralPath $SessionPath -Raw).Trim()
    }

    if ($ClaudeExit -ne 0 -or $ResultState -ne "success") {
        Write-Host ""
        Write-Host "[STATE] Interrupted repair tree:" -ForegroundColor Cyan
        git diff --ignore-cr-at-eol --name-status
        git status --short

        Write-Host "[LOG] $RawLog"

        if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($SessionId)) {
            Write-Host "[SESSION] $SessionId"
        }

        throw "Stage 4 narrow repair did not complete cleanly."
    }

    # ============================================================
    # HOST-SIDE VERIFICATION
    # ============================================================

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "============================================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host "[VERIFY] HOST STAGE 4 REPAIR VALIDATION" -ForegroundColor Cyan

        python Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent/tests/fresh_dispatch_smoke_test.py
    }

        python Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent/tests/dispatch_plan_smoke_test.py
    }

    }

    Invoke-Checked "Resource reservation" {
        python Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent/tests/resource_reservation_smoke_test.py
    }

    Invoke-Checked "Issue workflow" {

**ChatGPT:**

This is another PowerShell 5.1 wrapper problem, not a Git or Stage 4 problem.

The culprit is this combination:

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
git ... 2>$null

On Windows PowerShell 5.1, redirecting a native program's stderr can turn Git's harmless LF→CRLF warning into a PowerShell NativeCommandError. That's exactly what happened. No Stage 4 files were staged or committed before this stopped.

We don't need another model run. The candidate is already fully green and Sonnet's verdict is STAGE 4 READY TO COMMIT. 

Fix

In the commit runner, do not redirect Git stderr with 2>$null. Git warnings can print; they won't contaminate stdout, which is what we're capturing.

The two problematic places should be:

$TrackedReal = @(
    git diff --ignore-cr-at-eol --name-only |
        ForEach-Object { $_.Replace("\","/") } |
        Where-Object { -not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($_) }
)

and:

git diff --ignore-cr-at-eol --quiet -- "Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent/claim_refs.py"
$ClaimRefsCode = $LASTEXITCODE

Rather than make you edit the giant runner manually, here is a small preflight that proves we're clear and then you can rerun the commit runner after making those two removals:

& {
    $ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

    Set-Location "C:\NSC\NSC\NoSafeCircle"

    Write-Host "[CHECK] Stage 4 scope" -ForegroundColor Cyan

    $OldPreference = $ErrorActionPreference

    try {
        $ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"

        $TrackedReal = @(
            git diff --ignore-cr-at-eol --name-only |
                ForEach-Object { $_.Replace("\","/") } |
                Where-Object { -not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($_) }
        )

        $DiffCode = $LASTEXITCODE
    }
    finally {
        $ErrorActionPreference = $OldPreference
    }

    if ($DiffCode -ne 0) {
        throw "git diff failed with exit code $DiffCode."
    }

    Write-Host "[STATE] Real tracked changes:"
    $TrackedReal | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  $_" }

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "[CHECK] Stage 1 claim_refs.py" -ForegroundColor Cyan

    try {
        $ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"
        git diff --ignore-cr-at-eol --quiet -- "Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent/claim_refs.py"
        $ClaimRefsCode = $LASTEXITCODE
    }
    finally {
        $ErrorActionPreference = $OldPreference
    }

    if ($ClaimRefsCode -eq 1) {
        throw "claim_refs.py really has a Stage 4 content change."
    }

    if ($ClaimRefsCode -ne 0) {
        throw "git diff failed while checking claim_refs.py: $ClaimRefsCode."
    }

    Write-Host "[PASS] claim_refs.py unchanged" -ForegroundColor Green

    git diff --cached --quiet
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "Something is unexpectedly staged."
    }

    Write-Host "[PASS] Nothing staged or committed by the failed runner" -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host "[DONE] Stage 4 candidate is still ready for commit." -ForegroundColor Green
}

Use this hardened Stage 4 commit runner. It avoids 2>$null entirely and temporarily relaxes PowerShell native-command error handling around Git/GitHub commands while still checking every actual exit code.

& {
    $ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
    $env:PYTHONUTF8 = "1"
    $env:PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE = "1"

    $Root = "C:\NSC\NSC\NoSafeCircle"
    $Repo = "cathode26/NoSafeCircle"
    $Branch = "generic-get-work-stage4-contention-retry"

    Set-Location $Root

    # ============================================================
    # HELPERS
    # ============================================================

    function Invoke-Checked {
        param(
            [string]$Name,
            [scriptblock]$Command
        )

        Write-Host ""
        Write-Host "[TEST] $Name" -ForegroundColor Cyan

        & $Command

        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            throw "$Name failed."
        }

        Write-Host "[PASS] $Name" -ForegroundColor Green
    }

    function Invoke-GitSafe {
        param(
            [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)]
            [string[]]$Arguments,

            [int[]]$AllowedExitCodes = @(0),

            [switch]$Capture
        )

        $OldPreference = $ErrorActionPreference

        try {
            # Windows PowerShell 5.1 can promote harmless native stderr
            # warnings to NativeCommandError when ErrorActionPreference=Stop.
            $ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"

            if ($Capture) {
                $Output = @(& git @Arguments)
            }
            else {
                & git @Arguments | Out-Host
                $Output = @()
            }

            $Code = $LASTEXITCODE
        }
        finally {
            $ErrorActionPreference = $OldPreference
        }

        if ($AllowedExitCodes -notcontains $Code) {
            throw "git $($Arguments -join ' ') failed with exit code $Code."
        }

        return [pscustomobject]@{
            ExitCode = $Code
            Output   = $Output
        }
    }

    function Invoke-GhSafe {
        param(
            [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)]
            [string[]]$Arguments,

            [int[]]$AllowedExitCodes = @(0),

            [switch]$Capture
        )

        $OldPreference = $ErrorActionPreference

        try {
            $ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"

            if ($Capture) {
                $Output = @(& gh @Arguments)
            }
            else {
                & gh @Arguments | Out-Host
                $Output = @()
            }

            $Code = $LASTEXITCODE
        }
        finally {
            $ErrorActionPreference = $OldPreference
        }

        if ($AllowedExitCodes -notcontains $Code) {
            throw "gh $($Arguments -join ' ') failed with exit code $Code."
        }

        return [pscustomobject]@{
            ExitCode = $Code
            Output   = $Output
        }
    }

    Write-Host "============================================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host "[START] STAGE 4 -> COMMIT -> PR -> CI -> MAIN" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host "============================================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan

    if ((git branch --show-current).Trim() -ne $Branch) {
        throw "Expected $Branch."
    }

    # ============================================================
    # 1. VERIFY EXACT REVIEWED SCOPE
    # ============================================================

    $ExpectedFiles = @(
        ".github/workflows/task-review-agent-deterministic.yml",
        "Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent/Start-GameTaskAgent.ps1",
        "Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent/dispatch_plan.py",
        "Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent/fresh_dispatch.py",
        "Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent/issue_workflow_store.py",
        "Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent/run_pipeline_agent.py",
        "Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent/tests/ci_workflow_split_smoke_test.py",
        "Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent/tests/contention_retry_smoke_test.py",
        "Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent/tests/fresh_dispatch_smoke_test.py",
        "Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent/tests/issue_workflow_smoke_test.py"
    ) | Sort-Object

    $IndexCheck = Invoke-GitSafe `
        -Arguments @("diff","--cached","--quiet") `
        -AllowedExitCodes @(0,1)

    if ($IndexCheck.ExitCode -eq 1) {
        Invoke-GitSafe -Arguments @("diff","--cached","--name-status")
        throw "Index is not empty before Stage 4 staging."
    }

    $TrackedResult = Invoke-GitSafe `
        -Arguments @(
            "-c","core.safecrlf=false",
            "diff",
            "--ignore-cr-at-eol",
            "--name-only"
        ) `
        -Capture

    $TrackedReal = @(
        $TrackedResult.Output |
            ForEach-Object { ([string]$_).Replace("\","/") } |
            Where-Object { -not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($_) }
    )

    $UntrackedResult = Invoke-GitSafe `
        -Arguments @("ls-files","--others","--exclude-standard") `
        -Capture

    $Untracked = @(
        $UntrackedResult.Output |
            ForEach-Object { ([string]$_).Replace("\","/") } |
            Where-Object { -not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($_) }
    )

    $ActualFiles = @(
        $TrackedReal + $Untracked |
            Sort-Object -Unique
    )

    $Missing = @(
        $ExpectedFiles |
            Where-Object { $_ -notin $ActualFiles }
    )

    $Unexpected = @(
        $ActualFiles |
            Where-Object { $_ -notin $ExpectedFiles }
    )

    if ($Missing.Count -gt 0 -or $Unexpected.Count -gt 0) {
        if ($Missing.Count -gt 0) {
            Write-Host "[MISSING]" -ForegroundColor Red
            $Missing | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  $_" }
        }

        if ($Unexpected.Count -gt 0) {
            Write-Host "[UNEXPECTED]" -ForegroundColor Red
            $Unexpected | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  $_" }
        }

        throw "Working tree does not exactly match reviewed Stage 4 scope."
    }

    Write-Host "[PASS] Exact 10-file Stage 4 scope confirmed" -ForegroundColor Green

    # ============================================================
    # 2. PROVE STAGE 1 CLAIM CODE IS UNCHANGED
    # ============================================================

    $ClaimRefsCheck = Invoke-GitSafe `
        -Arguments @(
            "-c","core.safecrlf=false",
            "diff",
            "--ignore-cr-at-eol",
            "--quiet",
            "--",
            "Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent/claim_refs.py"
        ) `
        -AllowedExitCodes @(0,1)

    if ($ClaimRefsCheck.ExitCode -eq 1) {
        throw "Stage 1 claim_refs.py really has a content change."
    }

    Write-Host "[PASS] Stage 1 claim_refs.py unchanged" -ForegroundColor Green

    # ============================================================
    # 3. FINAL LOCAL VALIDATION
    # ============================================================

    Invoke-Checked "Stage 4 contention retry" {
        python Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent/tests/contention_retry_smoke_test.py
    }

    Invoke-Checked "Stage 3 fresh dispatch" {
        python Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent/tests/fresh_dispatch_smoke_test.py
    }

    Invoke-Checked "Stage 2 dispatch plan" {
        python Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent/tests/dispatch_plan_smoke_test.py
    }

    Invoke-Checked "Stage 1 claims" {
        python Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent/tests/claim_refs_smoke_test.py
    }

    Invoke-Checked "Resource reservations" {
        python Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent/tests/resource_reservation_smoke_test.py
    }

    Invoke-Checked "Durable Issue workflow" {
        python Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent/tests/issue_workflow_smoke_test.py
    }

    Invoke-Checked "Workflow runtime" {
        python Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent/tests/workflow_runtime_smoke_test.py
    }

    Invoke-Checked "Core CI routing" {
        python Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent/tests/ci_workflow_split_smoke_test.py
    }

    Invoke-Checked "TaskGraph" {
        python Pipeline/TaskGraph/taskcontrol.py validate
    }

    Invoke-Checked "Compile" {
        python -m compileall -q Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent
    }

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "[TEST] Scoped Stage 4 whitespace" -ForegroundColor Cyan

    $WhitespaceArgs = @(
        "-c","core.whitespace=cr-at-eol",
        "-c","core.safecrlf=false",
        "diff",
        "--check",
        "--"
    ) + $ExpectedFiles

    Invoke-GitSafe -Arguments $WhitespaceArgs | Out-Null

    Write-Host "[PASS] Scoped Stage 4 whitespace" -ForegroundColor Green

    # ============================================================
    # 4. COMMIT THE REVIEWED CANDIDATE FIRST
    # ============================================================

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "[WORK] Staging exact Stage 4 files" -ForegroundColor Cyan

    $AddArgs = @("add","--") + $ExpectedFiles
    Invoke-GitSafe -Arguments $AddArgs | Out-Null

    $StagedResult = Invoke-GitSafe `
        -Arguments @("diff","--cached","--name-only") `
        -Capture

    $Staged = @(
        $StagedResult.Output |
            ForEach-Object { ([string]$_).Replace("\","/") } |
            Sort-Object
    )

    $StageComparison = @(Compare-Object $ExpectedFiles $Staged)

    if ($StageComparison.Count -ne 0) {
        Invoke-GitSafe -Arguments @("diff","--cached","--name-status")
        throw "Staged files do not exactly equal reviewed Stage 4 scope."
    }

    Invoke-GitSafe `
        -Arguments @(
            "-c","core.whitespace=cr-at-eol",
            "-c","core.safecrlf=false",
            "diff",
            "--cached",
            "--check"
        ) | Out-Null

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "[STATE] Stage 4 staged diff:" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Invoke-GitSafe -Arguments @("diff","--cached","--stat") | Out-Null

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "[WORK] Committing reviewed Stage 4 candidate" -ForegroundColor Cyan

    Invoke-GitSafe `
        -Arguments @(
            "commit",
            "-m",
            "pipeline: add Stage 4 contention retry"
        ) | Out-Null

    $Stage4Commit = (
        (Invoke-GitSafe -Arguments @("rev-parse","HEAD") -Capture).Output |
            Select-Object -First 1
    ).Trim()

    Write-Host "[PASS] Stage 4 commit: $Stage4Commit" -ForegroundColor Green

    # ============================================================
    # 5. INTEGRATE CURRENT MAIN IF NECESSARY
    # ============================================================

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "[WORK] Refreshing origin/main" -ForegroundColor Cyan

    Invoke-GitSafe -Arguments @("fetch","origin","main") | Out-Null

    $AncestorCheck = Invoke-GitSafe `
        -Arguments @(
            "merge-base",
            "--is-ancestor",
            "origin/main",
            "HEAD"
        ) `
        -AllowedExitCodes @(0,1)

    if ($AncestorCheck.ExitCode -eq 1) {
        Write-Host "[WORK] main advanced; merging current main into Stage 4" -ForegroundColor Yellow

        Invoke-GitSafe `
            -Arguments @(
                "merge",
                "--no-edit",
                "origin/main"
            ) | Out-Null

        Invoke-Checked "Stage 4 after main integration" {
            python Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent/tests/contention_retry_smoke_test.py
        }

        Invoke-Checked "Fresh dispatch after main integration" {
            python Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent/tests/fresh_dispatch_smoke_test.py
        }

        Invoke-Checked "CI routing after main integration" {
            python Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent/tests/ci_workflow_split_smoke_test.py
        }

        Invoke-Checked "TaskGraph after main integration" {
            python Pipeline/TaskGraph/taskcontrol.py validate
        }
    }

    $Head = (
        (Invoke-GitSafe -Arguments @("rev-parse","HEAD") -Capture).Output |
            Select-Object -First 1
    ).Trim()

    Write-Host "[STATE] Final branch head to test: $Head"

    # ============================================================
    # 6. PUSH
    # ============================================================

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "[WORK] Pushing Stage 4 branch" -ForegroundColor Cyan

    Invoke-GitSafe `
        -Arguments @(
            "push",
            "-u",
            "origin",
            $Branch
        ) | Out-Null

    # ============================================================
    # 7. CREATE OR FIND PR
    # ============================================================

    $BodyPath = Join-Path $env:TEMP "nsc-stage4-pr-body.md"

    $Body = @'
## Stage 4 — Generic contention retry / N-worker dispatch

Extends generic no-TaskId dispatch so ordinary atomic claim contention does
not waste a worker invocation while other safe work is available.

### Generic behavior

- resume existing actionable durable work first
- otherwise select current safe Stage 2 fresh work
- atomically claim task/resources before Issue mutation
- on ordinary contention:
  - record the contended task for this invocation
  - refresh authoritative Stage 2 planning
  - preserve resume-first
  - select another untried safe candidate
- no arbitrary retry count
- pool exhaustion terminates normally
- explicit TaskId never substitutes
- observe mode remains read-only

### Fable concurrency repair

The adversarial review identified a post-claim TOCTOU where a valid durable
Issue/resource owner could appear after another worker had planned the task.

Only these positively typed benign cases are retryable:

- durable_ownership_by_other
- durable_resource_reservation_conflict

They map to ordinary claim_conflict.

Invalid, tampered, operational, unknown, untyped, cleanup-required, and other
Issue initialization failures remain terminal/fail-closed.

### Validation

- Stage 4 contention retry: 16 tests PASS
- Stage 3 fresh dispatch: 23 tests PASS
- Stage 2 dispatch plan: 30 tests PASS
- Stage 1 atomic claims: 27 tests PASS
- resource reservations: 7 tests PASS
- durable Issue workflow: 6 tests PASS
- workflow runtime: PASS
- Core CI split regression: PASS
- TaskGraph: PASS
- compile: PASS

Five-worker stress:
- 5 workers
- 5 distinct winners
- 10 contention attempts
- 0 leaked Stage 1 claims

Stage 5 decomposition remains disabled.
Autonomous dispatch remains disabled.
'@

    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(
        $BodyPath,
        (($Body -replace "`r`n","`n") -replace "`r","`n"),
        (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false))
    )

    $ExistingResult = Invoke-GhSafe `
        -Arguments @(
            "pr","list",
            "--repo",$Repo,
            "--head",$Branch,
            "--state","open",
            "--json","number",
            "--jq",".[0].number"
        ) `
        -Capture

    $ExistingPr = (
        $ExistingResult.Output -join ""
    ).Trim()

    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($ExistingPr)) {
        Invoke-GhSafe `
            -Arguments @(
                "pr","create",
                "--repo",$Repo,
                "--base","main",
                "--head",$Branch,
                "--title","Pipeline: add Stage 4 generic contention retry",
                "--body-file",$BodyPath
            ) | Out-Null
    }

    $PrJson = (
        Invoke-GhSafe `
            -Arguments @(
                "pr","view",
                $Branch,
                "--repo",$Repo,
                "--json","number,url,headRefOid,baseRefName,state"
            ) `
            -Capture
    ).Output -join "`n"

    $Pr = $PrJson | ConvertFrom-Json

    if ($Pr.state -ne "OPEN") {
        throw "Stage 4 PR is not open."
    }

    if ($Pr.baseRefName -ne "main") {
        throw "Stage 4 PR does not target main."
    }

    if ($Pr.headRefOid -ne $Head) {
        throw "PR head does not equal pushed Stage 4 head."
    }

    $PrNumber = [int]$Pr.number

    Write-Host "[STATE] PR #$PrNumber $($Pr.url)"

    # ============================================================
    # 8. WAIT FOR CI ON THE EXACT SHA, NOT PR-LEVEL STALE CHECKS
    # ============================================================

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "[WAIT] Waiting for exact-SHA CI: $Head" -ForegroundColor Cyan

    $SeenChecks = $false
    $StableGreenPolls = 0
    $LastCompletedCount = -1

    for ($i = 1; $i -le 120; $i++) {

        $CheckJson = (
            Invoke-GhSafe `
                -Arguments @(
                    "api",
                    "repos/$Repo/commits/$Head/check-runs"
                ) `
                -Capture
        ).Output -join "`n"

        $CheckData = $CheckJson | ConvertFrom-Json
        $Runs = @($CheckData.check_runs)

        if ($Runs.Count -eq 0) {
            Write-Host "[WAIT] No exact-SHA checks registered yet..."
            Start-Sleep -Seconds 5
            continue
        }

        $SeenChecks = $true

        $Failures = @(
            $Runs |
                Where-Object {
                    $_.status -eq "completed" -and
                    $_.conclusion -notin @(
                        "success",
                        "neutral",
                        "skipped"
                    )
                }
        )

        if ($Failures.Count -gt 0) {
            Write-Host "[BLOCKED] Exact-SHA CI failure:" -ForegroundColor Red

            $Failures |
                ForEach-Object {
                    Write-Host "  X $($_.name) -> $($_.conclusion)"
                }

            throw "Stage 4 CI failed for exact SHA $Head."
        }

        $Pending = @(
            $Runs |
                Where-Object {
                    $_.status -ne "completed"
                }
        )

        $Completed = @(
            $Runs |
                Where-Object {
                    $_.status -eq "completed"
                }
        )

        Write-Host (
            "[CI] total=" +
            $Runs.Count +
            " completed=" +
            $Completed.Count +
            " pending=" +
            $Pending.Count
        )

        if ($Pending.Count -eq 0) {
            if ($Completed.Count -eq $LastCompletedCount) {
                $StableGreenPolls++
            }
            else {
                $StableGreenPolls = 1
                $LastCompletedCount = $Completed.Count
            }

            # Three stable polls provide a registration grace period so a
            # late workflow cannot appear just after the first green check.
            if ($StableGreenPolls -ge 3) {
                break
            }
        }
        else {
            $StableGreenPolls = 0
            $LastCompletedCount = -1
        }

        Start-Sleep -Seconds 5
    }

    if (-not $SeenChecks) {
        throw "No CI checks ever registered for Stage 4 SHA $Head."
    }

    if ($StableGreenPolls -lt 3) {
        throw "Exact-SHA CI did not converge to stable green state."
    }

    Write-Host "[PASS] Exact-SHA Stage 4 CI is stably green" -ForegroundColor Green

    # Final PR-level sanity check now that exact head is known-green.
    Invoke-GhSafe `
        -Arguments @(
            "pr","checks",
            "$PrNumber",
            "--repo",$Repo
        ) | Out-Null

    # ============================================================
    # 9. VERIFY HEAD + MAIN BEFORE MERGE
    # ============================================================

    $FinalPrJson = (
        Invoke-GhSafe `
            -Arguments @(
                "pr","view",
                "$PrNumber",
                "--repo",$Repo,
                "--json","headRefOid,state"
            ) `
            -Capture
    ).Output -join "`n"

    $FinalPr = $FinalPrJson | ConvertFrom-Json

    if ($FinalPr.state -ne "OPEN") {
        throw "Stage 4 PR is no longer open."
    }

    if ($FinalPr.headRefOid -ne $Head) {
        throw "PR head changed after CI."
    }

    Invoke-GitSafe -Arguments @("fetch","origin","main") | Out-Null

    $FinalAncestor = Invoke-GitSafe `
        -Arguments @(
            "merge-base",
            "--is-ancestor",
            "origin/main",
            $Head
        ) `
        -AllowedExitCodes @(0,1)

    if ($FinalAncestor.ExitCode -eq 1) {
        throw "main advanced while Stage 4 CI ran. Reintegrate current main and rerun exact-SHA CI."
    }

    # ============================================================
    # 10. EXACT-SHA MERGE
    # ============================================================

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "[WORK] Merging exact CI-tested Stage 4 head" -ForegroundColor Cyan

    $MergeJson = (
        Invoke-GhSafe `
            -Arguments @(
                "api",
                "--method","PUT",
                "repos/$Repo/pulls/$PrNumber/merge",
                "-f","merge_method=merge",
                "-f","sha=$Head"
            ) `
            -Capture
    ).Output -join "`n"

    $Merge = $MergeJson | ConvertFrom-Json

    if (-not $Merge.merged) {
        throw "GitHub refused Stage 4 merge: $($Merge.message)"
    }

    # ============================================================
    # 11. UPDATE LOCAL MAIN
    # ============================================================

    Invoke-GitSafe -Arguments @("switch","main") | Out-Null
    Invoke-GitSafe -Arguments @("pull","--ff-only","origin","main") | Out-Null

    $Containment = Invoke-GitSafe `
        -Arguments @(
            "merge-base",
            "--is-ancestor",
            $Head,
            "main"
        ) `
        -AllowedExitCodes @(0,1)

    if ($Containment.ExitCode -ne 0) {
        throw "CI-tested Stage 4 head is not contained in local main."
    }

    $LocalMain = (
        (Invoke-GitSafe -Arguments @("rev-parse","HEAD") -Capture).Output |
            Select-Object -First 1
    ).Trim()

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "============================================================" -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host "[DONE] STAGE 4 IS IN MAIN" -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host "============================================================" -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host "[STATE] Reviewed Stage 4 commit: $Stage4Commit"
    Write-Host "[STATE] CI-tested branch head: $Head"
    Write-Host "[STATE] Merge commit: $($Merge.sha)"
    Write-Host "[STATE] Local main: $LocalMain"
}
