& {
    $ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
    $env:PYTHONUTF8 = "1"
    $env:PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE = "1"
    $env:PYTHONUNBUFFERED = "1"

    # ============================================================
    # GAUNTLET V2 — SYNC CURRENT STAGE 4 PRODUCTION PIPELINE
    # INTO THE COMPLETED SYNTHETIC FIXTURE
    # ============================================================

    $Root = "C:\NSC\NSC\OrchestratorGauntletBuilder"

    $V2Branch = "orchestrator-gauntlet-v2-large-stochastic"
    $BackupBranch = "orchestrator-gauntlet-v2-pre-stage4-sync"
    $SyncBranch = "orchestrator-gauntlet-v2-stage4-sync"

    $Model = "sonnet"
    $MaxTurns = 110

    $PromptPath = Join-Path $env:TEMP "nsc-gauntlet-stage4-production-sync.txt"
    $RawLog = Join-Path $env:TEMP (
        "nsc-gauntlet-stage4-production-sync-" +
        (Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd-HHmmss") +
        ".jsonl"
    )
    $SessionPath = Join-Path $env:TEMP (
        "nsc-gauntlet-stage4-production-sync-session-" +
        (Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd-HHmmss") +
        ".txt"
    )
    $ResultPath = Join-Path $env:TEMP (
        "nsc-gauntlet-stage4-production-sync-result-" +
        (Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd-HHmmss") +
        ".txt"
    )

    Set-Location $Root

    # ============================================================
    # HELPERS — WINDOWS POWERSHELL 5.1 SAFE
    # ============================================================

    function Invoke-GitSafe {
        param(
            [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)]
            [string[]]$Arguments,

            [int[]]$AllowedExitCodes = @(0),

            [switch]$Capture
        )

        $OldPreference = $ErrorActionPreference

        try {
            # Native Git warnings such as LF -> CRLF must not become
            # PowerShell NativeCommandError exceptions.
            $ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"

            if ($Capture) {
                $Output = @(& git @Arguments)
            }
            else {
                & git @Arguments | Out-Host
                $Output = @()
            }

            $Code = $LASTEXITCODE
        }
        finally {
            $ErrorActionPreference = $OldPreference
        }

        if ($AllowedExitCodes -notcontains $Code) {
            throw "git $($Arguments -join ' ') failed with exit code $Code."
        }

        return [pscustomobject]@{
            ExitCode = $Code
            Output   = $Output
        }
    }

    function Invoke-Checked {
        param(
            [string]$Name,
            [scriptblock]$Command
        )

        Write-Host ""
        Write-Host "[TEST] $Name" -ForegroundColor Cyan

        & $Command

        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            throw "$Name failed."
        }

        Write-Host "[PASS] $Name" -ForegroundColor Green
    }

    Write-Host "============================================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host "[START] GAUNTLET V2 <- CURRENT STAGE 4 PRODUCTION" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host "============================================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan

    # ============================================================
    # 1. REQUIRE COMPLETED, CLEAN V2
    # ============================================================

    $CurrentBranch = (
        (Invoke-GitSafe -Arguments @("branch","--show-current") -Capture).Output |
            Select-Object -First 1
    ).Trim()

    if ($CurrentBranch -ne $V2Branch) {
        throw "Expected completed V2 branch '$V2Branch'. Current: '$CurrentBranch'."
    }

    $V2Head = (
        (Invoke-GitSafe -Arguments @("rev-parse","HEAD") -Capture).Output |
            Select-Object -First 1
    ).Trim()

    Write-Host "[STATE] Completed V2 head: $V2Head"

    $TrackedDirty = Invoke-GitSafe `
        -Arguments @(
            "-c","core.safecrlf=false",
            "diff",
            "--ignore-cr-at-eol",
            "--quiet"
        ) `
        -AllowedExitCodes @(0,1)

    if ($TrackedDirty.ExitCode -eq 1) {
        Write-Host "[BLOCKED] Completed V2 has real unstaged content:" -ForegroundColor Red
        Invoke-GitSafe `
            -Arguments @(
                "-c","core.safecrlf=false",
                "diff",
                "--ignore-cr-at-eol",
                "--name-status"
            )
        throw "Gauntlet V2 must be clean before production sync."
    }

    $IndexDirty = Invoke-GitSafe `
        -Arguments @("diff","--cached","--quiet") `
        -AllowedExitCodes @(0,1)

    if ($IndexDirty.ExitCode -eq 1) {
        Invoke-GitSafe -Arguments @("diff","--cached","--name-status")
        throw "Gauntlet V2 index is not empty."
    }

    $Untracked = @(
        (Invoke-GitSafe `
            -Arguments @("ls-files","--others","--exclude-standard") `
            -Capture).Output
    )

    if ($Untracked.Count -gt 0) {
        Write-Host "[BLOCKED] Untracked files exist:" -ForegroundColor Red
        $Untracked | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  $_" }
        throw "Gauntlet V2 must be clean before production sync."
    }

    Write-Host "[PASS] Completed V2 working tree is clean" -ForegroundColor Green

    # ============================================================
    # 2. RECORD FIXTURE IDENTITY BEFORE MERGE
    # ============================================================

    $TasksTreeBefore = (
        (Invoke-GitSafe `
            -Arguments @("rev-parse","HEAD:Tasks") `
            -Capture).Output |
            Select-Object -First 1
    ).Trim()

    $ManifestBlobBefore = (
        (Invoke-GitSafe `
            -Arguments @(
                "rev-parse",
                "HEAD:Gauntlet/gauntlet_manifest.json"
            ) `
            -Capture).Output |
            Select-Object -First 1
    ).Trim()

    $WorkIdBlobBefore = (
        (Invoke-GitSafe `
            -Arguments @(
                "rev-parse",
                "HEAD:Pipeline/TaskGraph/WORK_ID_MAP.json"
            ) `
            -Capture).Output |
            Select-Object -First 1
    ).Trim()

    $ResourceBlobBefore = (
        (Invoke-GitSafe `
            -Arguments @(
                "rev-parse",
                "HEAD:Pipeline/TaskGraph/RESOURCE_GROUPS.yaml"
            ) `
            -Capture).Output |
            Select-Object -First 1
    ).Trim()

    $RequirementsBlobBefore = (
        (Invoke-GitSafe `
            -Arguments @(
                "rev-parse",
                "HEAD:Pipeline/TaskGraph/PROJECT_REQUIREMENTS.yaml"
            ) `
            -Capture).Output |
            Select-Object -First 1
    ).Trim()

    Write-Host "[STATE] Synthetic Tasks tree: $TasksTreeBefore"

    # ============================================================
    # 3. FETCH CURRENT PRODUCTION MAIN
    # ============================================================

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "[READ] Fetching current production main" -ForegroundColor Cyan

    Invoke-GitSafe -Arguments @("fetch","origin","main") | Out-Null

    $ProductionMain = (
        (Invoke-GitSafe `
            -Arguments @("rev-parse","origin/main") `
            -Capture).Output |
            Select-Object -First 1
    ).Trim()

    Write-Host "[STATE] Production main: $ProductionMain"

    # ============================================================
    # 4. PROVE FETCHED MAIN REALLY CONTAINS STAGE 4
    # ============================================================

    $Stage4TestExists = Invoke-GitSafe `
        -Arguments @(
            "cat-file",
            "-e",
            "origin/main:Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent/tests/contention_retry_smoke_test.py"
        ) `
        -AllowedExitCodes @(0,1)

    if ($Stage4TestExists.ExitCode -ne 0) {
        throw "origin/main does not contain Stage 4 contention_retry_smoke_test.py."
    }

    $FreshDispatchMain = (
        Invoke-GitSafe `
            -Arguments @(
                "show",
                "origin/main:Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent/fresh_dispatch.py"
            ) `
            -Capture
    ).Output -join "`n"

    if (-not $FreshDispatchMain.Contains("resolve_generic_dispatch_with_contention_retry")) {
        throw "origin/main does not contain the Stage 4 contention-retry resolver."
    }

    $IssueStoreMain = (
        Invoke-GitSafe `
            -Arguments @(
                "show",
                "origin/main:Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent/issue_workflow_store.py"
            ) `
            -Capture
    ).Output -join "`n"

    if (-not $IssueStoreMain.Contains("durable_ownership_by_other")) {
        throw "origin/main is missing the Fable durable-ownership race repair."
    }

    if (-not $IssueStoreMain.Contains("durable_resource_reservation_conflict")) {
        throw "origin/main is missing the Fable resource-contention race repair."
    }

    Write-Host "[PASS] Fetched production main contains completed Stage 4" -ForegroundColor Green

    # ============================================================
    # 5. PRESERVE A PERMANENT PRE-SYNC POINTER
    # ============================================================

    $BackupExists = Invoke-GitSafe `
        -Arguments @(
            "show-ref",
            "--verify",
            "--quiet",
            "refs/heads/$BackupBranch"
        ) `
        -AllowedExitCodes @(0,1)

    if ($BackupExists.ExitCode -eq 0) {
        $BackupHead = (
            (Invoke-GitSafe `
                -Arguments @("rev-parse",$BackupBranch) `
                -Capture).Output |
                Select-Object -First 1
        ).Trim()

        if ($BackupHead -ne $V2Head) {
            throw "$BackupBranch already exists at $BackupHead, expected $V2Head."
        }

        Write-Host "[STATE] Existing V2 backup already points to $V2Head"
    }
    else {
        Invoke-GitSafe `
            -Arguments @(
                "branch",
                $BackupBranch,
                $V2Head
            ) | Out-Null

        Write-Host "[PASS] Preserved V2 as $BackupBranch" -ForegroundColor Green
    }

    # ============================================================
    # 6. CREATE DEDICATED SYNC BRANCH
    # ============================================================

    $SyncExists = Invoke-GitSafe `
        -Arguments @(
            "show-ref",
            "--verify",
            "--quiet",
            "refs/heads/$SyncBranch"
        ) `
        -AllowedExitCodes @(0,1)

    if ($SyncExists.ExitCode -eq 0) {
        throw "$SyncBranch already exists. Inspect/resume it rather than starting another sync."
    }

    Invoke-GitSafe `
        -Arguments @(
            "switch",
            "-c",
            $SyncBranch
        ) | Out-Null

    Write-Host "[PASS] Sync branch: $SyncBranch" -ForegroundColor Green

    # ============================================================

Do not reveal hidden chain-of-thought.

    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(
        $PromptPath,
        (($Prompt -replace "`r`n", "`n") -replace "`r", "`n"),
        (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false))
    )

    if (Test-Path $SessionPath) {
        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $SessionPath -Force
    }

    if (Test-Path $ResultPath) {
        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $ResultPath -Force
    }

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "[AGENT] Launching Sonnet production-sync agent" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host "[MODEL] $Model"
    Write-Host "[MAX-TURNS] $MaxTurns"
    Write-Host "[PROMPT] $PromptPath"
    Write-Host "[LOG] $RawLog"
    Write-Host ""

    # ============================================================
    # 8. RUN SONNET
    # ============================================================

    $PreviousErrorPreference = $ErrorActionPreference

    try {
        $ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"

        Get-Content -LiteralPath $PromptPath -Raw -Encoding UTF8 |
            docker compose -p nosafecircle run --rm -T claude `
                claude -p `
                --model $Model `
                --max-turns $MaxTurns `
                --permission-mode dontAsk `
                --output-format stream-json `
                --verbose `
                --include-partial-messages `
                --tools Read,Glob,Grep,Edit,Write,Bash `
                --allowedTools Read Glob Grep Edit Write Bash `
                --disallowedTools NotebookEdit WebSearch WebFetch 2>&1 |
            Tee-Object -FilePath $RawLog |
            ForEach-Object {
                $Line = [string]$_

                try {
                    $Event = $Line | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop
                }
                catch {
                    if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Line)) {
                        Write-Host "[RAW] $Line" -ForegroundColor DarkGray
                    }
                    return
                }

                if ($Event.type -eq "system") {
                    if ($Event.subtype -eq "init") {
                        Write-Host "[AGENT] Sync session started" -ForegroundColor Cyan

                        if ($Event.session_id) {
                            [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(
                                $SessionPath,
                                [string]$Event.session_id,
                                (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false))
                            )

                            Write-Host "[SESSION] $($Event.session_id)" -ForegroundColor DarkCyan
                        }
                    }
                    elseif ($Event.subtype -eq "api_retry") {
                        Write-Host "[RETRY] API retry $($Event.attempt)/$($Event.max_retries)" -ForegroundColor Yellow
                    }
                }
                elseif ($Event.type -eq "stream_event") {
                    $Inner = $Event.event

                    if (
                        $Inner.type -eq "content_block_start" -and
                        $Inner.content_block.type -eq "tool_use"
                    ) {
                        Write-Host ""
                        Write-Host "[TOOL] $($Inner.content_block.name)" -ForegroundColor DarkCyan
                    }
                    elseif (
                        $Inner.type -eq "content_block_delta" -and
                        $Inner.delta.type -eq "text_delta"
                    ) {
                        Write-Host $Inner.delta.text -NoNewline
                    }
                    elseif ($Inner.type -eq "message_stop") {
                        Write-Host ""
                    }
                }
                elseif ($Event.type -eq "result") {
                    Write-Host ""

                    if ($Event.session_id) {
                        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(
                            $SessionPath,
                            [string]$Event.session_id,
                            (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false))
                        )
                    }

                    if ($Event.is_error) {
                        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(
                            $ResultPath,
                            "error",
                            (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false))
                        )

                        Write-Host "[BLOCKED] Production sync agent returned an error" -ForegroundColor Red
                    }
                    else {
                        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(
                            $ResultPath,
                            "success",
                            (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false))
                        )

                        Write-Host "[DONE] Production sync agent completed" -ForegroundColor Green
                    }

                    if ($null -ne $Event.total_cost_usd) {
                        Write-Host "[USAGE] Cost: `$$($Event.total_cost_usd)"
                    }
                }
            }

        $ClaudeExit = $LASTEXITCODE
    }
    finally {
        $ErrorActionPreference = $PreviousErrorPreference
    }

    $ResultState = ""

    if (Test-Path $ResultPath) {
        $ResultState = (
            Get-Content -LiteralPath $ResultPath -Raw
        ).Trim()
    }

    $ClaudeSession = ""

    if (Test-Path $SessionPath) {
        $ClaudeSession = (
            Get-Content -LiteralPath $SessionPath -Raw
        ).Trim()
    }

    if ($ClaudeExit -ne 0 -or $ResultState -ne "success") {
        Write-Host ""
        Write-Host "[STATE] Sync branch after interrupted agent:" -ForegroundColor Cyan
        Invoke-GitSafe -Arguments @("status","--short")

        Write-Host ""
        Write-Host "[LOG] $RawLog"

        if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($ClaudeSession)) {
            Write-Host "[SESSION] $ClaudeSession"
        }

        throw "Gauntlet Stage 4 production sync did not finish cleanly."
    }

    # ============================================================
    # 9. REQUIRE CLEAN COMMITTED RESULT
    # ============================================================

    $PostStatus = @(
        (Invoke-GitSafe `
            -Arguments @("status","--porcelain=v1","--untracked-files=all") `
            -Capture).Output
    )

    if ($PostStatus.Count -gt 0) {
        Write-Host "[BLOCKED] Sync agent left uncommitted content:" -ForegroundColor Red
        $PostStatus | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  $_" }
        throw "Production sync must finish with committed local history."
    }

    $SyncedHead = (
        (Invoke-GitSafe -Arguments @("rev-parse","HEAD") -Capture).Output |
            Select-Object -First 1
    ).Trim()

    Write-Host "[STATE] Synced HEAD: $SyncedHead"

    # ============================================================
    # 10. PROVE BOTH HISTORIES SURVIVE
    # ============================================================

    $V2Ancestor = Invoke-GitSafe `
        -Arguments @(
            "merge-base",
            "--is-ancestor",
            $V2Head,
            "HEAD"
        ) `
        -AllowedExitCodes @(0,1)

    if ($V2Ancestor.ExitCode -ne 0) {
        throw "Original completed V2 history is not an ancestor of synced HEAD."
    }

    $ProductionAncestor = Invoke-GitSafe `
        -Arguments @(
            "merge-base",
            "--is-ancestor",
            $ProductionMain,
            "HEAD"
        ) `
        -AllowedExitCodes @(0,1)

    if ($ProductionAncestor.ExitCode -ne 0) {
        throw "Current production main is not an ancestor of synced HEAD."
    }

    Write-Host "[PASS] Both V2 and production Stage 4 histories are preserved" -ForegroundColor Green

    # ============================================================
    # 11. PROVE SYNTHETIC TASK DATA WAS NOT REPLACED
    # ============================================================

    $TasksTreeAfter = (
        (Invoke-GitSafe `
            -Arguments @("rev-parse","HEAD:Tasks") `
            -Capture).Output |
            Select-Object -First 1
    ).Trim()

    if ($TasksTreeAfter -ne $TasksTreeBefore) {
        throw "Synthetic Tasks tree changed during production sync."
    }

    $ManifestBlobAfter = (
        (Invoke-GitSafe `
            -Arguments @(
                "rev-parse",
                "HEAD:Gauntlet/gauntlet_manifest.json"
            ) `
            -Capture).Output |
            Select-Object -First 1
    ).Trim()

    if ($ManifestBlobAfter -ne $ManifestBlobBefore) {
        throw "Gauntlet manifest unexpectedly changed during production sync."
    }

    $WorkIdBlobAfter = (
        (Invoke-GitSafe `
            -Arguments @(
                "rev-parse",
                "HEAD:Pipeline/TaskGraph/WORK_ID_MAP.json"
            ) `
            -Capture).Output |
            Select-Object -First 1
    ).Trim()

    $ResourceBlobAfter = (
        (Invoke-GitSafe `
            -Arguments @(
                "rev-parse",
                "HEAD:Pipeline/TaskGraph/RESOURCE_GROUPS.yaml"
            ) `
            -Capture).Output |
            Select-Object -First 1
    ).Trim()

    $RequirementsBlobAfter = (
        (Invoke-GitSafe `
            -Arguments @(
                "rev-parse",
                "HEAD:Pipeline/TaskGraph/PROJECT_REQUIREMENTS.yaml"
            ) `
            -Capture).Output |
            Select-Object -First 1
    ).Trim()

    if ($WorkIdBlobAfter -ne $WorkIdBlobBefore) {
        throw "Synthetic WORK_ID_MAP.json changed during sync."
    }

    if ($ResourceBlobAfter -ne $ResourceBlobBefore) {
        throw "Synthetic RESOURCE_GROUPS.yaml changed during sync."
    }

    if ($RequirementsBlobAfter -ne $RequirementsBlobBefore) {
        throw "Synthetic PROJECT_REQUIREMENTS.yaml changed during sync."
    }

    Write-Host "[PASS] Synthetic TaskGraph fixture data preserved byte-for-byte" -ForegroundColor Green

    # ============================================================
    # 12. PROVE TASKREVIEWAGENT IS EXACT CURRENT PRODUCTION CODE
    # ============================================================

    $TaskReviewDiff = Invoke-GitSafe `
        -Arguments @(
            "-c","core.safecrlf=false",
            "diff",
            "--quiet",
            "origin/main",
            "--",
            "Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent"
        ) `
        -AllowedExitCodes @(0,1)

    if ($TaskReviewDiff.ExitCode -ne 0) {
        Write-Host "[BLOCKED] Synced TaskReviewAgent differs from production main:" -ForegroundColor Red

        Invoke-GitSafe `
            -Arguments @(
                "-c","core.safecrlf=false",
                "diff",
                "--name-status",
                "origin/main",
                "--",
                "Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent"
            )

        throw "Gauntlet is not running the exact current production TaskReviewAgent."
    }

    Write-Host "[PASS] TaskReviewAgent exactly matches current production main" -ForegroundColor Green

    # TaskGraph Python engine files should also match production.
    $TaskGraphPythonDiff = @(
        (Invoke-GitSafe `
            -Arguments @(
                "-c","core.safecrlf=false",
                "diff",
                "--name-only",
                "origin/main",
                "--",
                "Pipeline/TaskGraph"
            ) `
            -Capture).Output |
            Where-Object {
                ([string]$_) -match "\.py$"
            }
    )

    if ($TaskGraphPythonDiff.Count -gt 0) {
        Write-Host "[BLOCKED] TaskGraph engine Python differs from production:" -ForegroundColor Red
        $TaskGraphPythonDiff | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  $_" }
        throw "Current production TaskGraph engine was not fully adopted."
    }

    Write-Host "[PASS] TaskGraph Python engine matches current production main" -ForegroundColor Green

    # ============================================================
    # 13. PROVE VERIFIER NOW REFERENCES ACTUAL STAGE 2 KERNEL

    function Invoke-GitSafe {
        param(
            [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)]
            [string[]]$Arguments,

            [int[]]$AllowedExitCodes = @(0),

            [switch]$Capture
        )

        $Old = $ErrorActionPreference

        try {
            $ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"

            if ($Capture) {
                $Output = @(& git @Arguments)
            }
            else {
                & git @Arguments | Out-Host
                $Output = @()
            }

            $Code = $LASTEXITCODE
        }
        finally {
            $ErrorActionPreference = $Old
        }

        if ($AllowedExitCodes -notcontains $Code) {
            throw "git $($Arguments -join ' ') failed with exit code $Code."
        }

        return [pscustomobject]@{
            ExitCode = $Code
            Output   = $Output
        }
    }

        Write-Host "[TEST] $Name" -ForegroundColor Cyan

        & $Command

        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            throw "$Name failed."
        }

        Write-Host "[PASS] $Name" -ForegroundColor Green

    function Invoke-GitSafe {
        param(
            [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)]
            [string[]]$Arguments,

            [int[]]$AllowedExitCodes = @(0),

            [switch]$Capture
        )

        $Old = $ErrorActionPreference

        try {
            $ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"

            if ($Capture) {
                $Output = @(& git @Arguments)
            }
            else {
                & git @Arguments | Out-Host
                $Output = @()
            }

            $Code = $LASTEXITCODE
        }
        finally {
            $ErrorActionPreference = $Old
        }

        if ($AllowedExitCodes -notcontains $Code) {
            throw "git $($Arguments -join ' ') failed with exit code $Code."
        }

        return [pscustomobject]@{
            ExitCode = $Code
            Output   = $Output
        }
    }

            $ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"
            & $Command
            $Code = $LASTEXITCODE

        finally {
            $ErrorActionPreference = $Old

    function Invoke-GitSafe {
        param(
            [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)]
            [string[]]$Arguments,

            [int[]]$AllowedExitCodes = @(0),

            [switch]$Capture
        )

        $Old = $ErrorActionPreference

        try {
            $ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"

            if ($Capture) {
                $Output = @(& git @Arguments)
            }
            else {
                & git @Arguments | Out-Host
                $Output = @()
            }

            $Code = $LASTEXITCODE
        }
        finally {
            $ErrorActionPreference = $Old
        }

        if ($AllowedExitCodes -notcontains $Code) {
            throw "git $($Arguments -join ' ') failed with exit code $Code."
        }

        return [pscustomobject]@{
            ExitCode = $Code
            Output   = $Output
        }
    }

    function Invoke-Checked {
        param(
            [string]$Name,
            [scriptblock]$Command
        )

        Write-Host ""
        Write-Host "[TEST] $Name" -ForegroundColor Cyan

        $Old = $ErrorActionPreference

        try {
            $ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"
            & $Command
            $Code = $LASTEXITCODE
        }
        finally {
            $ErrorActionPreference = $Old
        }

        if ($Code -ne 0) {
            throw "$Name failed with exit code $Code."
        }

        Write-Host "[PASS] $Name" -ForegroundColor Green
    }

    function Get-RealChangedFiles {
        return @(
            (Invoke-GitSafe `
                -Arguments @(
                    "-c","core.safecrlf=false",
                    "diff",
                    "--ignore-cr-at-eol",
                    "--name-only"
                ) `
                -Capture).Output |
            ForEach-Object {
                ([string]$_).Replace("\","/")
            } |
            Where-Object {
                -not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($_)
            } |
            Sort-Object
        )
    }

    function Get-RepoStatus {
        return @(
            (Invoke-GitSafe `
                -Arguments @(
                    "status",
                    "--porcelain=v1",
                    "--untracked-files=all"
                ) `
                -Capture).Output |
            ForEach-Object { [string]$_ }
        )
    }

    function Get-CandidateHashes {

            $Hashes[$File] = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $NativePath -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
        }

        return $Hashes
    }

                --permission-mode dontAsk `
                --output-format stream-json `
                --verbose `
                --include-partial-messages `
                --tools Read,Glob,Grep `
                --allowedTools Read Glob Grep `
                --disallowedTools Bash Edit Write NotebookEdit WebSearch WebFetch 2>&1 |
            Tee-Object -FilePath $RawLog |
            ForEach-Object {
                $Line = [string]$_

                try {
                    $Event = $Line | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop
                }
                catch {
                    if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Line)) {
                        Write-Host "[RAW] $Line" -ForegroundColor DarkGray
                    }
                    return
                }

                if ($Event.type -eq "system") {
                    if ($Event.subtype -eq "init") {
                        Write-Host "[REVIEW] Fable session started" -ForegroundColor Cyan

                        if ($Event.session_id) {
                            [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(
                                $SessionPath,
                                [string]$Event.session_id,
                                (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false))
                            )

                            Write-Host "[SESSION] $($Event.session_id)" -ForegroundColor DarkCyan
                        }
                    }
                    elseif ($Event.subtype -eq "api_retry") {
                        Write-Host "[RETRY] API $($Event.attempt)/$($Event.max_retries)" -ForegroundColor Yellow
                    }
                }
                elseif ($Event.type -eq "stream_event") {
                    $Inner = $Event.event

                    if (
                        $Inner.type -eq "content_block_start" -and
                        $Inner.content_block.type -eq "tool_use"
                    ) {
                        Write-Host ""
                        Write-Host "[TOOL] $($Inner.content_block.name)" -ForegroundColor DarkCyan
                    }
                    elseif (
                        $Inner.type -eq "content_block_delta" -and
                        $Inner.delta.type -eq "text_delta"
                    ) {
                        $Delta = [string]$Inner.delta.text

                        Write-Host $Delta -NoNewline

                        [System.IO.File]::AppendAllText(
                            $ReviewTextPath,
                            $Delta,
                            (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false))
                        )
                    }
                    elseif ($Inner.type -eq "message_stop") {
                        Write-Host ""
                    }
                }
                elseif ($Event.type -eq "result") {
                    Write-Host ""

                    if ($Event.session_id) {
                        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(
                            $SessionPath,
                            [string]$Event.session_id,
                            (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false))
                        )
                    }

                    if ($null -ne $Event.result) {
                        $FinalResultText = [string]$Event.result
                    }

                    if ($Event.is_error) {
                        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(
                            $ResultPath,
                            "error",
                            (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false))
                        )

                        Write-Host "[BLOCKED] Fable returned an error" -ForegroundColor Red
                    }
                    else {
                        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(
                            $ResultPath,
                            "success",
                            (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false))
                        )

                        Write-Host "[DONE] Fable review completed" -ForegroundColor Green
                    }

                    if ($null -ne $Event.total_cost_usd) {
                        Write-Host "[USAGE] Cost: `$$($Event.total_cost_usd)"
                    }
                }
            }

        $FableExit = $LASTEXITCODE
    }
    finally {
        $ErrorActionPreference = $Old
    }

    # ============================================================
    # 5. PROVE FABLE DID NOT TOUCH THE CANDIDATE
    # ============================================================

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "[CHECK] Verifying read-only review invariants" -ForegroundColor Cyan

    Assert-CandidateImmutable `
        -ExpectedFiles $ExpectedFiles `
        -StatusBefore $StatusBefore `
        -HashesBefore $HashesBefore `
        -DiffHashBefore $DiffHashBefore

    # ============================================================
    # 6. REQUIRE CLEAN FABLE COMPLETION
    # ============================================================

    $ResultState = ""

    if (Test-Path $ResultPath) {
        $ResultState = (
            Get-Content -LiteralPath $ResultPath -Raw
        ).Trim()
    }

    $FableSession = ""

    if (Test-Path $SessionPath) {
        $FableSession = (
            Get-Content -LiteralPath $SessionPath -Raw
        ).Trim()
    }

    if ($FableExit -ne 0 -or $ResultState -ne "success") {
        Write-Host ""
        Write-Host "============================================================" -ForegroundColor Red
        Write-Host "[BLOCKED] FABLE REVIEW DID NOT COMPLETE" -ForegroundColor Red
        Write-Host "============================================================" -ForegroundColor Red
        Write-Host "[LOG] $RawLog"

        if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($FableSession)) {
            Write-Host "[SESSION] $FableSession"
            Write-Host "[NEXT] Preserve and resume this exact Fable session. Do not restart the review." -ForegroundColor Yellow
        }

        throw "Final Fable review did not complete cleanly."
    }

    # ============================================================
    # 7. POST-REVIEW DIRECT REGRESSION CHECK
    # ============================================================

    Invoke-Checked "Issue workflow post-review" {
        python Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent/tests/issue_workflow_smoke_test.py
    }

    Invoke-Checked "Real checkout post-review" {
        python Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent/tests/real_checkout_smoke_test.py
    }

    Invoke-Checked "Downstream post-review" {
        python Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent/tests/downstream_smoke_test.py
    }

    $ClaimRefsAfter = Invoke-GitSafe `
        -Arguments @(
            "-c","core.safecrlf=false",
            "diff",
            "--ignore-cr-at-eol",
            "--quiet",
            "--",
            "Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent/claim_refs.py"
        ) `
        -AllowedExitCodes @(0,1)

    if ($ClaimRefsAfter.ExitCode -ne 0) {
        throw "claim_refs.py changed."
    }

    Assert-CandidateImmutable `
        -ExpectedFiles $ExpectedFiles `
        -StatusBefore $StatusBefore `
        -HashesBefore $HashesBefore `
        -DiffHashBefore $DiffHashBefore

    # ============================================================
    # 8. PARSE EXACT FABLE VERDICT
    # ============================================================

    $ReviewText = ""

    if (Test-Path $ReviewTextPath) {
        $ReviewText = Get-Content -LiteralPath $ReviewTextPath -Raw
    }

    if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($FinalResultText)) {
        $ReviewText = $ReviewText + "`n" + $FinalResultText
    }

    $Ready = $ReviewText.Contains(
        "STAGE 4 REPOSITORY BINDING READY TO COMMIT"
    )

    $Narrow = $ReviewText.Contains(
        "STAGE 4 REPOSITORY BINDING READY AFTER NARROW REPAIRS"
    )

    $NotReady = $ReviewText.Contains(
        "STAGE 4 REPOSITORY BINDING NOT READY"
    )

    $VerdictCount = 0

    if ($Ready)    { $VerdictCount++ }
    if ($Narrow)   { $VerdictCount++ }
    if ($NotReady) { $VerdictCount++ }

    if ($VerdictCount -ne 1) {
        Write-Host ""
        Write-Host "[BLOCKED] Could not identify exactly one Fable verdict." -ForegroundColor Red
        Write-Host "[TEXT] $ReviewTextPath"
        Write-Host "[LOG] $RawLog"
        throw "Fable verdict was missing or ambiguous."
    }

    $Verdict = ""

    if ($Ready) {
        $Verdict = "STAGE 4 REPOSITORY BINDING READY TO COMMIT"
    }
    elseif ($Narrow) {
        $Verdict = "STAGE 4 REPOSITORY BINDING READY AFTER NARROW REPAIRS"
    }
    else {
        $Verdict = "STAGE 4 REPOSITORY BINDING NOT READY"
    }

    # ============================================================
    # 9. FINAL STATE
    # ============================================================

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "============================================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host "[VERDICT] $Verdict" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host "============================================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "[STATE] Branch: $Branch"
    Write-Host "[STATE] HEAD: $ExpectedHead"
    Write-Host "[STATE] Candidate diff SHA256: $DiffHashBefore"
    Write-Host "[STATE] Nothing staged."
    Write-Host "[STATE] Nothing committed."
    Write-Host "[STATE] Nothing pushed."
    Write-Host "[STATE] Fable made no repository changes."

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "[STATE] Working tree:" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    git status --short

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "[TEXT] $ReviewTextPath"
    Write-Host "[LOG] $RawLog"

    if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($FableSession)) {
        Write-Host "[SESSION] $FableSession"
    }

    Write-Host ""

    if ($Ready) {
        Write-Host "============================================================" -ForegroundColor Green
        Write-Host "[PASS] FINAL FABLE REVIEW APPROVED STAGE 4.1" -ForegroundColor Green
        Write-Host "============================================================" -ForegroundColor Green
        Write-Host "[NEXT] Send me this output. Next is the hardened commit / push / PR / exact-SHA CI / merge runner." -ForegroundColor Green
    }
    elseif ($Narrow) {
        Write-Host "============================================================" -ForegroundColor Yellow
        Write-Host "[WORK] FABLE FOUND NARROW PRE-COMMIT REPAIRS" -ForegroundColor Yellow
        Write-Host "============================================================" -ForegroundColor Yellow
        Write-Host "[NEXT] Send me this output. Do NOT commit. We will repair only Fable's concrete findings." -ForegroundColor Yellow
    }
    else {
        Write-Host "============================================================" -ForegroundColor Red
        Write-Host "[BLOCKED] FABLE DOES NOT APPROVE STAGE 4.1" -ForegroundColor Red
        Write-Host "============================================================" -ForegroundColor Red
        Write-Host "[NEXT] Send me this output. Do NOT commit." -ForegroundColor Yellow
    }
}

This is deliberately a much nastier review than asking Fable “does this look okay?” It gets the exact uncommitted diff, can inspect all related production code, but receives no shell or mutation tools.     function Invoke-GitSafe {
        param(
            [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)]
            [string[]]$Arguments,

            [int[]]$AllowedExitCodes = @(0),

            [switch]$Capture
        )

        $Old = $ErrorActionPreference

        try {
            $ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"

            if ($Capture) {
                $Output = @(& git @Arguments)
            }
            else {
                & git @Arguments | Out-Host
                $Output = @()
            }

            $Code = $LASTEXITCODE
        }
        finally {
            $ErrorActionPreference = $Old
        }

        if ($AllowedExitCodes -notcontains $Code) {
            throw "git $($Arguments -join ' ') failed with exit code $Code."
        }

        return [pscustomobject]@{
            ExitCode = $Code
            Output   = $Output
        }
    }

    function Invoke-Checked {
        param(
            [string]$Name,
            [scriptblock]$Command
        )

        Write-Host ""
        Write-Host "[TEST] $Name" -ForegroundColor Cyan

        $Old = $ErrorActionPreference

        try {
            $ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"
            & $Command
            $Code = $LASTEXITCODE
        }
        finally {
            $ErrorActionPreference = $Old
        }

        if ($Code -ne 0) {
            throw "$Name failed with exit code $Code."
        }

        Write-Host "[PASS] $Name" -ForegroundColor Green
    }

    function Invoke-GitSafe {
        param(
            [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)]
            [string[]]$Arguments,

            [int[]]$AllowedExitCodes = @(0),

            [switch]$Capture
        )

        $Old = $ErrorActionPreference

        try {
            $ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"

            if ($Capture) {
                $Output = @(& git @Arguments)
            }
            else {
                & git @Arguments | Out-Host
                $Output = @()
            }

            $Code = $LASTEXITCODE
        }
        finally {
            $ErrorActionPreference = $Old
        }

        if ($AllowedExitCodes -notcontains $Code) {
            throw "git $($Arguments -join ' ') failed with exit code $Code."
        }

        return [pscustomobject]@{
            ExitCode = $Code
            Output   = $Output
        }
    }

    function Invoke-Checked {
        param(
            [string]$Name,
            [scriptblock]$Command
        )

        Write-Host ""
        Write-Host "[TEST] $Name" -ForegroundColor Cyan

        $Old = $ErrorActionPreference

        try {
            $ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"
            & $Command
            $Code = $LASTEXITCODE
        }
        finally {
            $ErrorActionPreference = $Old
        }

        if ($Code -ne 0) {
            throw "$Name failed with exit code $Code."
        }

        Write-Host "[PASS] $Name" -ForegroundColor Green
    }

    function Get-RealChangedFiles {
        return @(

                    "--name-only"

            } |

    }

        foreach ($File in $ExpectedFiles) {

        )

            throw "Working-tree status changed during Fable review."
        }

        $DiffArgs = @(

            "--no-ext-diff",

        ) + $ExpectedFiles

        $Bytes = $Utf8.GetBytes($DiffTextAfter)

                [System.BitConverter]::ToString(
                    $Sha.ComputeHash($Bytes)
                )

        }

        }

            throw "Candidate real diff changed during Fable review."
        }

    function Invoke-GitSafe {
        param(
            [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)]
            [string[]]$Arguments,

            [int[]]$AllowedExitCodes = @(0),

            [switch]$Capture
        )

        $Old = $ErrorActionPreference

        try {
            $ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"

            if ($Capture) {
                $Output = @(& git @Arguments)
            }
            else {
                & git @Arguments | Out-Host
                $Output = @()
            }

            $Code = $LASTEXITCODE
        }
        finally {
            $ErrorActionPreference = $Old
        }

        if ($AllowedExitCodes -notcontains $Code) {
            throw "git $($Arguments -join ' ') failed with exit code $Code."
        }

        return [pscustomobject]@{
            ExitCode = $Code
            Output   = $Output
        }
    }

    function Invoke-GhSafe {
        param(
            [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)]
            [string[]]$Arguments,

            [int[]]$AllowedExitCodes = @(0),

            [switch]$Capture
        )

        $Old = $ErrorActionPreference

        try {
            $ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"

            if ($Capture) {
                $Output = @(& gh @Arguments)
            }
            else {
                & gh @Arguments | Out-Host
                $Output = @()
            }

            $Code = $LASTEXITCODE
        }
        finally {
            $ErrorActionPreference = $Old
        }

        if ($AllowedExitCodes -notcontains $Code) {
            throw "gh $($Arguments -join ' ') failed with exit code $Code."
        }

        return [pscustomobject]@{
            ExitCode = $Code
            Output   = $Output
        }
    }

    function Invoke-Checked {
        param(
            [string]$Name,
            [scriptblock]$Command
        )

        Write-Host ""
        Write-Host "[TEST] $Name" -ForegroundColor Cyan

        $Old = $ErrorActionPreference

        try {
            $ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"
            & $Command
            $Code = $LASTEXITCODE
        }
        finally {
            $ErrorActionPreference = $Old
        }

        if ($Code -ne 0) {
            throw "$Name failed with exit code $Code."
        }

        Write-Host "[PASS] $Name" -ForegroundColor Green
    }

                    Tee-Object -FilePath $AttemptLog |
                    ForEach-Object {
                        Write-Host ([string]$_)
                    }

                $Code = $LASTEXITCODE
            }
            finally {
                $ErrorActionPreference = $Old
            }

            if ($Code -eq 0) {
                Write-Host "[PASS] Stage 4 contention retry" -ForegroundColor Green
                return
            }

            $Text = Get-Content -LiteralPath $AttemptLog -Raw

            $IsStressFixture =
                $Text -match "nsc-stage4-stress-" -and
                $Text -match "remote\.git"

            $IsPermissionDenied =
                $Text -match "Permission denied"

            $CorrectClassification =
                $Text -match "claim_operational_error"

            $KnownLockFlake =
                $Text -match "refs/nsc/claims/.+\.lock"

            $KnownObjectStoreFlake =
                $Text -match "unable to migrate objects to permanent storage"

            $ExactWindowsFixtureFlake =
                $IsStressFixture -and
                $IsPermissionDenied -and
                $CorrectClassification -and
                (
                    $KnownLockFlake -or
                    $KnownObjectStoreFlake
                )

            if ($ExactWindowsFixtureFlake -and $Attempt -lt 5) {
                Write-Host ""
                Write-Host "[RETRY] Windows temporary bare-repo test fixture filesystem failure." -ForegroundColor Yellow
                Write-Host "[CHECK] Production correctly classified it as claim_operational_error." -ForegroundColor Yellow
                Write-Host "[CHECK] Retrying TEST ONLY." -ForegroundColor Yellow

                Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
                continue
            }

            Write-Host ""
            Write-Host "[BLOCKED] Stage 4 produced a real non-whitelisted failure." -ForegroundColor Red
            Write-Host "[LOG] $AttemptLog"

            throw "Stage 4 contention test failed."
        }

        throw "Stage 4 did not complete one clean stress run."
    }

    Set-Location $Root

    Write-Host "============================================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host "[START] DELIVER STAGE 4.1 REPOSITORY BINDING" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host "============================================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan

    # ============================================================
    # 1. EXACT REVIEWED CHECKPOINT
    # ============================================================

    $CurrentBranch = (
        (Invoke-GitSafe `
            -Arguments @("branch","--show-current") `
            -Capture).Output |
        Select-Object -First 1
    ).Trim()

    if ($CurrentBranch -ne $Branch) {
        throw "Expected '$Branch'. Current: '$CurrentBranch'."
    }

    $CurrentHead = (
        (Invoke-GitSafe `
            -Arguments @("rev-parse","HEAD") `
            -Capture).Output |
        Select-Object -First 1
    ).Trim()

    if ($CurrentHead -ne $ExpectedBaseHead) {
        throw "Reviewed base HEAD changed: $CurrentHead"
    }

    $Index = Invoke-GitSafe `
        -Arguments @("diff","--cached","--quiet") `
        -AllowedExitCodes @(0,1)

    if ($Index.ExitCode -ne 0) {
        throw "Index is not empty."
    }

    $Untracked = @(
        (Invoke-GitSafe `
            -Arguments @(
                "ls-files",
                "--others",
                "--exclude-standard"
            ) `
            -Capture).Output
    )

    if ($Untracked.Count -ne 0) {
        Write-Host "[BLOCKED] Untracked files:" -ForegroundColor Red
        $Untracked | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  $_" }
        throw "Reviewed delivery requires no untracked files."
    }

    $CurrentFiles = Get-RealChangedFiles

    $ScopeDiff = @(
        Compare-Object $ExpectedFiles $CurrentFiles
    )

    if ($ScopeDiff.Count -ne 0) {
        Write-Host "[BLOCKED] Reviewed file scope changed." -ForegroundColor Red

        Write-Host "[EXPECTED]"
        $ExpectedFiles | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  $_" }

        Write-Host "[ACTUAL]"
        $CurrentFiles | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  $_" }

        throw "Do not commit a candidate different from the Fable-approved one."
    }

    $ClaimRefsCheck = Invoke-GitSafe `
        -Arguments @(
            "-c","core.safecrlf=false",
            "diff",
            "--ignore-cr-at-eol",
            "--quiet",
            "--",
            "Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent/claim_refs.py"
        ) `
        -AllowedExitCodes @(0,1)

    if ($ClaimRefsCheck.ExitCode -ne 0) {
        throw "claim_refs.py changed."
    }

    Write-Host "[PASS] Exact Fable-approved eight-file candidate" -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host "[PASS] claim_refs.py unchanged" -ForegroundColor Green

    # ============================================================
    # 2. VERIFY GITHUB AUTHORITY + CURRENT MAIN
    # ============================================================

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "[READ] Verifying GitHub repository identity" -ForegroundColor Cyan

    Invoke-GhSafe -Arguments @("auth","status") | Out-Null

    $Repository = (
        (Invoke-GhSafe `
            -Arguments @(
                "repo","view",
                "--json","nameWithOwner",
                "--jq",".nameWithOwner"
            ) `
            -Capture).Output |
        Select-Object -First 1
    ).Trim()

    if ($Repository -ne $ExpectedRepository) {
        throw "Current checkout resolves to GitHub repository '$Repository', expected '$ExpectedRepository'."
    }

    Write-Host "[PASS] GitHub repository: $Repository" -ForegroundColor Green

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "[READ] Fetching origin/main before commit" -ForegroundColor Cyan

    Invoke-GitSafe `
        -Arguments @("fetch","origin","main") |
        Out-Null

    $OriginMainBefore = (
        (Invoke-GitSafe `
            -Arguments @("rev-parse","origin/main") `
            -Capture).Output |
        Select-Object -First 1
    ).Trim()

    if ($OriginMainBefore -ne $ExpectedBaseHead) {
        Write-Host "[BLOCKED] origin/main advanced since the reviewed candidate was based." -ForegroundColor Red
        Write-Host "[REVIEWED BASE] $ExpectedBaseHead"
        Write-Host "[CURRENT MAIN]  $OriginMainBefore"
        throw "Do not merge an integration context that Fable did not review."
    }

    Write-Host "[PASS] origin/main still equals reviewed base HEAD" -ForegroundColor Green

    # ============================================================
    # 3. FINAL PRE-COMMIT REGRESSION
    # ============================================================

    Invoke-Checked "Issue workflow" {
        python Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent/tests/issue_workflow_smoke_test.py
    }

    Invoke-Checked "Real checkout" {
        python Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent/tests/real_checkout_smoke_test.py
    }

    Invoke-Checked "Durable checkout" {
        python Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent/tests/durable_checkout_smoke_test.py
    }

    Invoke-Checked "Resumable checkout" {
        python Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent/tests/resumable_checkout_smoke_test.py
    }

    Invoke-Checked "Downstream" {
        python Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent/tests/downstream_smoke_test.py
    }

    Invoke-Checked "Mainline reintegration" {
        python Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent/tests/mainline_reintegration_smoke_test.py
    }

    Invoke-Checked "Stage 2 dispatch" {
        python Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent/tests/dispatch_plan_smoke_test.py
    }

    Invoke-Checked "Stage 3 fresh dispatch" {
        python Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent/tests/fresh_dispatch_smoke_test.py
    }

    Invoke-Stage4StressChecked

    Invoke-Checked "Stage 1 claims" {
        python Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent/tests/claim_refs_smoke_test.py
    }

    Invoke-Checked "Resource reservations" {
        python Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent/tests/resource_reservation_smoke_test.py
    }

    Invoke-Checked "Workflow runtime" {
        python Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent/tests/workflow_runtime_smoke_test.py
    }

    Invoke-Checked "CI routing" {
        python Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent/tests/ci_workflow_split_smoke_test.py
    }

    Invoke-Checked "TaskGraph" {
        python Pipeline/TaskGraph/taskcontrol.py validate
    }

    Invoke-Checked "Compile" {
        python -m compileall -q Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent
    }

    $WhitespaceArgs = @(
        "-c","core.whitespace=cr-at-eol",
        "-c","core.safecrlf=false",
        "diff",
        "--check",
        "--"
    ) + $ExpectedFiles

    Invoke-GitSafe -Arguments $WhitespaceArgs | Out-Null

    Write-Host "[PASS] Scoped whitespace validation" -ForegroundColor Green

    # Re-prove tests did not mutate candidate scope.

    $AfterTestsFiles = Get-RealChangedFiles

    if (@(Compare-Object $ExpectedFiles $AfterTestsFiles).Count -ne 0) {
        throw "Pre-commit tests changed the reviewed candidate."
    }

    if ((git rev-parse HEAD).Trim() -ne $ExpectedBaseHead) {
        throw "HEAD changed during pre-commit validation."
    }

    # ============================================================
    # 4. EXACT STAGING — NEVER git add -A
    # ============================================================

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "[WORK] Staging exactly eight reviewed files" -ForegroundColor Cyan

    $AddArgs = @(
        "-c","core.safecrlf=false",
        "add",
        "--"
    ) + $ExpectedFiles

    Invoke-GitSafe -Arguments $AddArgs | Out-Null

    $StagedFiles = @(
        (Invoke-GitSafe `
            -Arguments @(
                "diff",
                "--cached",
                "--name-only"
            ) `
            -Capture).Output |
        ForEach-Object {
            ([string]$_).Replace("\","/")
        } |
        Where-Object {
            -not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($_)
        } |
        Sort-Object
    )

    $StagedScopeDiff = @(
        Compare-Object $ExpectedFiles $StagedFiles
    )

    if ($StagedScopeDiff.Count -ne 0) {
        Write-Host "[BLOCKED] Staged scope is wrong." -ForegroundColor Red

        Write-Host "[EXPECTED]"
        $ExpectedFiles | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  $_" }

        Write-Host "[STAGED]"
        $StagedFiles | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  $_" }

        throw "Refusing commit."
    }

    $UnstagedReal = Invoke-GitSafe `
        -Arguments @(
            "-c","core.safecrlf=false",
            "diff",
            "--ignore-cr-at-eol",
            "--quiet"
        ) `
        -AllowedExitCodes @(0,1)

    if ($UnstagedReal.ExitCode -ne 0) {
        Write-Host "[BLOCKED] Real unstaged content remains after exact staging." -ForegroundColor Red

        Invoke-GitSafe `
            -Arguments @(
                "-c","core.safecrlf=false",
                "diff",
                "--ignore-cr-at-eol",
                "--name-status"
            )

        throw "Refusing partial commit."
    }

    $CachedWhitespaceArgs = @(
        "-c","core.whitespace=cr-at-eol",
        "-c","core.safecrlf=false",
        "diff",
        "--cached",
        "--check",
        "--"
    ) + $ExpectedFiles

    Invoke-GitSafe -Arguments $CachedWhitespaceArgs | Out-Null

    Write-Host "[PASS] Exact reviewed staging verified" -ForegroundColor Green

    # ============================================================
    # 5. COMMIT
    # ============================================================

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "[WORK] Creating Stage 4.1 commit" -ForegroundColor Cyan

    Invoke-GitSafe `
        -Arguments @(
            "commit",
            "-m",
            $CommitMessage
        ) |
        Out-Null

    $CommitSha = (
        (Invoke-GitSafe `
            -Arguments @("rev-parse","HEAD") `
            -Capture).Output |
        Select-Object -First 1
    ).Trim()

    Write-Host "[PASS] Commit: $CommitSha" -ForegroundColor Green

    $PostCommitStatus = @(
        (Invoke-GitSafe `
            -Arguments @(
                "status",
                "--porcelain=v1",
                "--untracked-files=all"
            ) `
            -Capture).Output
    )

    if ($PostCommitStatus.Count -ne 0) {
        Write-Host "[BLOCKED] Commit did not leave a clean tree:" -ForegroundColor Red
        $PostCommitStatus | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  $_" }
        throw "Do not push a dirty post-commit state."
    }

    $Parent = (
        (Invoke-GitSafe `
            -Arguments @("rev-parse","HEAD^") `
            -Capture).Output |
        Select-Object -First 1
    ).Trim()

    if ($Parent -ne $ExpectedBaseHead) {
        throw "Commit parent is not the exact reviewed base."
    }

    Write-Host "[PASS] Commit parent is exact reviewed main SHA" -ForegroundColor Green

    # ============================================================
    # 6. PUSH BRANCH — NO FORCE
    # ============================================================

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "[WORK] Pushing branch" -ForegroundColor Cyan

    Invoke-GitSafe `
        -Arguments @(
            "push",
            "-u",
            "origin",
            $Branch
        ) |
        Out-Null

    $RemoteBranchSha = (
        (Invoke-GitSafe `
            -Arguments @(
                "rev-parse",
                "origin/$Branch"
            ) `
            -Capture).Output |
        Select-Object -First 1
    ).Trim()

    if ($RemoteBranchSha -ne $CommitSha) {
        throw "Remote branch does not point to exact commit."
    }

    Write-Host "[PASS] Remote branch == $CommitSha" -ForegroundColor Green

    # ============================================================
    # 7. CREATE OR REUSE EXACT PR
    # ============================================================

    $PrBody = @"
## Stage 4.1 — Repository Binding Safety

This patch removes implicit production-repository authority from active
TaskReviewAgent Issue, checkout, and downstream PR/Issue paths.

### Guarantees

- source checkout origin binds GhIssueBackend repository
- explicit repository values are assertions, not fallback authority
- real/durable/resumable task checkouts are bound to controller origin
- cross-repository task checkouts fail closed
- downstream PR/Issue commands use the checkout-bound repository
- checkout/backend mismatch fails before gh invocation
- credential-bearing rejected origins are redacted
- missing controller origin fails closed
- Stage 1 claim semantics remain unchanged
- claim_refs.py has zero functional change
- Stage 5 remains outside scope
- autonomous dispatch remains disabled

### Validation

- Issue workflow: PASS
- Real checkout: PASS
- Durable checkout: PASS
- Resumable checkout: PASS
- Downstream: PASS
- Mainline reintegration: PASS
- Stage 2: PASS
- Stage 3: PASS
- Stage 4: PASS
- Stage 1: PASS
- Resource reservations: PASS
- Workflow runtime: PASS
- CI routing: PASS
- TaskGraph: PASS
- Compile: PASS

Final adversarial Fable verdict:

STAGE 4 REPOSITORY BINDING READY TO COMMIT

Exact commit:

$CommitSha
"@

    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(
        $PrBodyPath,
        (($PrBody -replace "`r`n","`n") -replace "`r","`n"),
        (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false))
    )

    $ExistingPrJson = (
        (Invoke-GhSafe `
            -Arguments @(
                "pr","list",
                "--repo",$Repository,
                "--head",$Branch,
                "--state","open",
                "--json","number,url,headRefOid"
            ) `
            -Capture).Output -join "`n"
    )

    $ExistingPrs = @(
        $ExistingPrJson | ConvertFrom-Json
    )

    if ($ExistingPrs.Count -gt 1) {
        throw "More than one open PR exists for $Branch."
    }

    if ($ExistingPrs.Count -eq 1) {
        $PrNumber = [int]$ExistingPrs[0].number
        $PrUrl = [string]$ExistingPrs[0].url

        if ([string]$ExistingPrs[0].headRefOid -ne $CommitSha) {
            throw "Existing PR points to a different head SHA."
        }

        Write-Host "[STATE] Reusing PR #$PrNumber"
    }
    else {
        Write-Host ""
        Write-Host "[WORK] Creating pull request" -ForegroundColor Cyan

        Invoke-GhSafe `
            -Arguments @(
                "pr","create",
                "--repo",$Repository,
                "--base","main",
                "--head",$Branch,
                "--title",$PrTitle,
                "--body-file",$PrBodyPath
            ) |
            Out-Null

        $CreatedPrJson = (
            (Invoke-GhSafe `
                -Arguments @(
                    "pr","list",
                    "--repo",$Repository,
                    "--head",$Branch,
                    "--state","open",
                    "--json","number,url,headRefOid"
                ) `
                -Capture).Output -join "`n"
        )

        $CreatedPrs = @(
            $CreatedPrJson | ConvertFrom-Json
        )

        if ($CreatedPrs.Count -ne 1) {
            throw "Could not resolve exactly one created PR."
        }

        $PrNumber = [int]$CreatedPrs[0].number
        $PrUrl = [string]$CreatedPrs[0].url

        if ([string]$CreatedPrs[0].headRefOid -ne $CommitSha) {
            throw "Created PR does not point to exact commit."
        }
    }

    Write-Host "[PASS] PR #$PrNumber: $PrUrl" -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host "[PASS] PR head == $CommitSha" -ForegroundColor Green

    # ============================================================
    # 8. WAIT FOR CHECKS ON THE EXACT SHA
    # ============================================================

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "[WAIT] Waiting for exact-SHA CI to appear" -ForegroundColor Cyan

    $RequiredWorkflow = "TaskReviewAgent Deterministic Validation"
    $RequiredJob = "windows-smoke"

    $FoundRequiredCheck = $false

    for ($Attempt = 1; $Attempt -le 90; $Attempt++) {

        $PrStateJson = (
            (Invoke-GhSafe `
                -Arguments @(
                    "pr","view",
                    "$PrNumber",
                    "--repo",$Repository,
                    "--json",
                    "headRefOid,statusCheckRollup,state,url"
                ) `
                -Capture).Output -join "`n"
        )

        $PrState = $PrStateJson | ConvertFrom-Json

        if ([string]$PrState.headRefOid -ne $CommitSha) {
            throw "PR head changed while waiting for CI."
        }

        $Checks = @($PrState.statusCheckRollup)

        $Required = @(
            $Checks |
            Where-Object {
                $_.__typename -eq "CheckRun" -and
                $_.name -eq $RequiredJob -and
                $_.workflowName -eq $RequiredWorkflow
            }
        )

        if ($Required.Count -gt 0) {
            $FoundRequiredCheck = $true
            Write-Host "[PASS] Exact Stage 4.1 CI check appeared on $CommitSha" -ForegroundColor Green
            break
        }

        if ($Attempt % 6 -eq 0) {
            Write-Host "[WAIT] CI not visible yet ($Attempt/90)" -ForegroundColor Yellow
        }

        Start-Sleep -Seconds 5
    }

    if (-not $FoundRequiredCheck) {
        throw "Required exact-SHA CI check never appeared."
    }

    # ============================================================
    # 9. WATCH PR CHECKS
    # ============================================================

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "[WAIT] Watching PR checks" -ForegroundColor Cyan

    Invoke-GhSafe `
        -Arguments @(
            "pr","checks",
            "$PrNumber",
            "--repo",$Repository,
            "--watch",
            "--fail-fast",
            "--interval","10"
        ) |
        Out-Null

    # ============================================================
    # 10. VERIFY EXACT REQUIRED CHECK CONCLUSION
    # ============================================================

    $FinalPrJson = (
        (Invoke-GhSafe `
            -Arguments @(
                "pr","view",
                "$PrNumber",
                "--repo",$Repository,
                "--json",
                "headRefOid,statusCheckRollup,state,mergeable,mergeStateStatus,url"
            ) `
            -Capture).Output -join "`n"
    )

    $FinalPr = $FinalPrJson | ConvertFrom-Json

    if ([string]$FinalPr.headRefOid -ne $CommitSha) {
        throw "PR head changed after CI."
    }

    $FinalChecks = @($FinalPr.statusCheckRollup)

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "[STATE] Exact-head checks:" -ForegroundColor Cyan

    foreach ($Check in $FinalChecks) {
        if ($Check.__typename -eq "CheckRun") {
            Write-Host (
                "  " +
                $Check.workflowName +
                "/" +
                $Check.name +
                " status=" +
                $Check.status +
                " conclusion=" +
                $Check.conclusion
            )
        }
        else {
            Write-Host (
                "  " +
                $Check.context +
                " state=" +
                $Check.state
            )
        }
    }

    $RequiredFinal = @(
        $FinalChecks |
        Where-Object {
            $_.__typename -eq "CheckRun" -and
            $_.name -eq $RequiredJob -and
            $_.workflowName -eq $RequiredWorkflow
        }
    )

    if ($RequiredFinal.Count -ne 1) {
        throw "Could not establish exactly one required deterministic validation check."
    }

    if ([string]$RequiredFinal[0].conclusion -ne "SUCCESS") {
        throw "Required deterministic validation did not conclude SUCCESS."
    }

    $BadCheckConclusions = @(
        "FAILURE",
        "CANCELLED",
        "TIMED_OUT",
        "ACTION_REQUIRED",
        "STALE",
        "STARTUP_FAILURE"
    )

    $BadCheckRuns = @(
        $FinalChecks |
        Where-Object {
            $_.__typename -eq "CheckRun" -and
            $_.conclusion -in $BadCheckConclusions
        }
    )

    if ($BadCheckRuns.Count -gt 0) {
        throw "At least one exact-head GitHub check has a failing conclusion."
    }

    $BadStatuses = @(
        $FinalChecks |
        Where-Object {
            $_.__typename -eq "StatusContext" -and
            $_.state -in @("ERROR","FAILURE")
        }
    )

    if ($BadStatuses.Count -gt 0) {
        throw "At least one exact-head status context failed."
    }

    Write-Host "[PASS] Exact-SHA CI is green" -ForegroundColor Green

    # ============================================================
    # 11. REFUSE TO MERGE IF MAIN ADVANCED DURING CI
    # ============================================================

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "[READ] Rechecking main before merge" -ForegroundColor Cyan

    Invoke-GitSafe `
        -Arguments @("fetch","origin","main") |
        Out-Null

    $OriginMainBeforeMerge = (
        (Invoke-GitSafe `
            -Arguments @("rev-parse","origin/main") `
            -Capture).Output |
        Select-Object -First 1
    ).Trim()

    if ($OriginMainBeforeMerge -ne $ExpectedBaseHead) {
        Write-Host "[BLOCKED] main advanced while Stage 4.1 CI was running." -ForegroundColor Red
        Write-Host "[REVIEWED BASE] $ExpectedBaseHead"
        Write-Host "[CURRENT MAIN]  $OriginMainBeforeMerge"
        Write-Host "[PR] $PrUrl"
        throw "Do not merge without integrating/revalidating the newer main."
    }

    # Re-read PR once more immediately before mutation.

    $PreMergeJson = (
        (Invoke-GhSafe `
            -Arguments @(
                "pr","view",
                "$PrNumber",
                "--repo",$Repository,
                "--json",
                "headRefOid,state,mergeable,mergeStateStatus"
            ) `
            -Capture).Output -join "`n"
    )

    $PreMerge = $PreMergeJson | ConvertFrom-Json

    if ([string]$PreMerge.headRefOid -ne $CommitSha) {
        throw "PR head changed immediately before merge."
    }

    if ([string]$PreMerge.state -ne "OPEN") {
        throw "PR is no longer open."
    }

    if ([string]$PreMerge.mergeable -eq "CONFLICTING") {
        throw "PR is conflicting."
    }

    Write-Host "[PASS] Main and PR head still match reviewed integration state" -ForegroundColor Green

    # ============================================================
    # 12. MERGE
    # ============================================================

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "[WORK] Merging PR #$PrNumber" -ForegroundColor Cyan

    Invoke-GhSafe `
        -Arguments @(
            "pr","merge",
            "$PrNumber",
            "--repo",$Repository,
            "--merge",
            "--match-head-commit",$CommitSha
        ) |
        Out-Null

    # ============================================================
    # 13. PROVE PR REALLY MERGED
    # ============================================================

    $MergedJson = (
        (Invoke-GhSafe `
            -Arguments @(
                "pr","view",
                "$PrNumber",
                "--repo",$Repository,
                "--json",
                "state,mergedAt,mergeCommit,headRefOid,url"
            ) `
            -Capture).Output -join "`n"
    )

    $MergedPr = $MergedJson | ConvertFrom-Json

    if ([string]$MergedPr.state -ne "MERGED") {
        throw "PR did not reach MERGED state."
    }

    if ([string]$MergedPr.headRefOid -ne $CommitSha) {
        throw "Merged PR head SHA differs from reviewed commit."
    }

    $MergeSha = [string]$MergedPr.mergeCommit.oid

    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($MergeSha)) {
        throw "GitHub did not report a merge commit SHA."
    }

    Write-Host "[PASS] PR merged" -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host "[STATE] Merge commit: $MergeSha"

    # ============================================================
    # 14. VERIFY REMOTE MAIN CONTAINS EXACT COMMIT
    # ============================================================

    Invoke-GitSafe `
        -Arguments @("fetch","origin","main") |
        Out-Null

    $PatchContained = Invoke-GitSafe `
        -Arguments @(
            "merge-base",
            "--is-ancestor",
            $CommitSha,
            "origin/main"
        ) `
        -AllowedExitCodes @(0,1)

    if ($PatchContained.ExitCode -ne 0) {
        throw "Stage 4.1 commit is not contained in origin/main."
    }

    $MergeContained = Invoke-GitSafe `
        -Arguments @(
            "merge-base",
            "--is-ancestor",
            $MergeSha,
            "origin/main"
        ) `
        -AllowedExitCodes @(0,1)

    if ($MergeContained.ExitCode -ne 0) {
        throw "Reported merge commit is not contained in origin/main."
    }

    Write-Host "[PASS] Exact Stage 4.1 commit is contained in origin/main" -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host "[PASS] Merge commit is contained in origin/main" -ForegroundColor Green

    # ============================================================
    # 15. UPDATE LOCAL MAIN
    # ============================================================

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "[WORK] Updating local main" -ForegroundColor Cyan

    Invoke-GitSafe `
        -Arguments @("switch","main") |
        Out-Null

    Invoke-GitSafe `
        -Arguments @(
            "pull",
            "--ff-only",
            "origin",
            "main"
        ) |
        Out-Null

    $LocalMain = (
        (Invoke-GitSafe `
            -Arguments @("rev-parse","HEAD") `
            -Capture).Output |
        Select-Object -First 1
    ).Trim()

    $OriginMainFinal = (
        (Invoke-GitSafe `
            -Arguments @("rev-parse","origin/main") `
            -Capture).Output |
        Select-Object -First 1
    ).Trim()

    if ($LocalMain -ne $OriginMainFinal) {
        throw "Local main does not exactly match origin/main."
    }

    $LocalPatchContained = Invoke-GitSafe `
        -Arguments @(
            "merge-base",
            "--is-ancestor",
            $CommitSha,
            "HEAD"
        ) `
        -AllowedExitCodes @(0,1)

    if ($LocalPatchContained.ExitCode -ne 0) {
        throw "Stage 4.1 patch commit is not contained in local main."
    }

    $FinalStatus = @(
        (Invoke-GitSafe `
            -Arguments @(
                "status",
                "--porcelain=v1",
                "--untracked-files=all"
            ) `
            -Capture).Output
    )

    if ($FinalStatus.Count -ne 0) {
        Write-Host "[BLOCKED] Local main is not clean:" -ForegroundColor Red
        $FinalStatus | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  $_" }
        throw "Merged repository did not finish cleanly."
    }

    # ============================================================
    # 16. FINAL REPORT
    # ============================================================

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "============================================================" -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host "[DONE] STAGE 4.1 REPOSITORY BINDING IS IN MAIN" -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host "============================================================" -ForegroundColor Green

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "[STATE] Repository: $Repository"
    Write-Host "[STATE] Reviewed base: $ExpectedBaseHead"
    Write-Host "[STATE] Patch commit: $CommitSha"
    Write-Host "[STATE] PR: #$PrNumber $PrUrl"
    Write-Host "[STATE] Merge commit: $MergeSha"
    Write-Host "[STATE] Current main: $LocalMain"
    Write-Host "[STATE] Local main == origin/main"
    Write-Host "[STATE] Working tree clean"
    Write-Host "[STATE] Stage 4.1 exact-SHA CI green"
    Write-Host "[STATE] Fable verdict: STAGE 4 REPOSITORY BINDING READY TO COMMIT"

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "[STATE] Recent main history:" -ForegroundColor Cyan

    Invoke-GitSafe `
        -Arguments @(
            "log",
            "--oneline",
            "--decorate",
            "-12"
        )

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "[NEXT] Stage 4.1 is finished. Next we update the Gauntlet template with this new main, create its dedicated private GitHub repo, bootstrap the synthetic Issues, and finally run the real live multi-worker Gauntlet." -ForegroundColor Green
}
